	function estimateBandwidth() {

var PROGRESSION_STORAGE_KEY = "sid_progression_v2";
/**
* [GUARD_10] Firebase Realtime Database 通信基盤（PeerJS互換アダプタ）
* - 設定(firebaseConfig)は localStorage に保存。未設定の場合は従来の PeerJS を使用（フォールバック）。
* - プレイヤーノード/ホストノードに onDisconnect().remove() を設定し、切断で自動退出。
* - ホスト消失時は入室順(ID順)先頭の残存プレイヤーがトランザクションで hostId を引き継ぐ（ホスト移譲）。
* - 全員退出時はルームデータを自動削除。
*/
var FB_CONFIG_KEY = "sid_firebase_config_v1";
/** 共有のデフォルトFirebase構成。ここに firebaseConfig（apiKey/databaseURL等）を貼ると、全員が設定不要で同じDBに接続する */
var FB_DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	apiKey: "AIzaSyBWgehb6oIAI2URwu6VkrKzvM0mEglKnRA",
	authDomain: "among-us-10057.firebaseapp.com",
	databaseURL: "https://among-us-10057-default-rtdb.asia-southeast1.firebasedatabase.app",
	projectId: "among-us-10057",
	storageBucket: "among-us-10057.firebasestorage.app",
	messagingSenderId: "334837153503",
	appId: "1:334837153503:web:83b73a002404f190fb336a"
};
var FB = {
	cfg: null,
	db: null,
	ready: null,
	loadCfg() {
		try {
			/* 招待URLの ?fb=<base64(config)> で共通Firebase構成を自動取り込み（他PCへ設定を共有） */
			const q = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("fb");
			if (q) {
				const parsed = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(q))));
				if (parsed && parsed.apiKey && parsed.databaseURL) localStorage.setItem(FB_CONFIG_KEY, JSON.stringify(parsed));
			}
		} catch (e) {
			console.warn("[Firebase] ?fb パラメータの解析に失敗", e);
		}
		try {
			const raw = localStorage.getItem(FB_CONFIG_KEY);
			const c = raw && JSON.parse(raw);
			if (c && c.apiKey && c.databaseURL) return c;
		} catch {}
		return FB_DEFAULT_CONFIG && FB_DEFAULT_CONFIG.apiKey && FB_DEFAULT_CONFIG.databaseURL ? FB_DEFAULT_CONFIG : null;
	},
	encodeCfg() {
		try {
			return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(FB.cfg))));
		} catch {
			return "";
		}
	},
	loadScript(src) {
		return new Promise((res, rej) => {
			const el = document.createElement("script");
			el.src = src;
			el.onload = res;
			el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Firebase SDK の読み込みに失敗: " + src));
			document.head.appendChild(el);
		});
	},
	init() {
		const base = "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.2/";
		FB.ready = FB.loadScript(base + "firebase-app-compat.js").then(() => FB.loadScript(base + "firebase-database-compat.js")).then(() => {
			const fbk = window.firebase;
			if (!fbk.apps.length) fbk.initializeApp(FB.cfg);
			FB.db = fbk.database();
		}).catch((e) => {
			console.error("[Firebase] init failed", e, e && e.stack);
			throw e;
		});
		FB.ready.catch(() => {});
	},
	watchPublic(cb) {
		let ref = null;
		let handler = null;
		let dead = false;
		(FB.ready || Promise.resolve()).then(() => {
			if (dead || !FB.db) return;
			ref = FB.db.ref("sid/public");
			handler = (snap) => {
				const v = snap.val() || {};
				const now = Date.now();
				cb(Object.values(v).filter((r) => r && now - (r.updatedAt || 0) < 6e4).sort((a, b) => (b.updatedAt || 0) - (a.updatedAt || 0)).slice(0, 12));
			};
			ref.on("value", handler);
		}).catch(() => {});
		return () => {
			dead = true;
			if (ref && handler) ref.off("value", handler);
		};
	}
};
FB.cfg = FB.loadCfg();
if (FB.cfg) FB.init();
/** 通信方式: "p2p"(既定: PeerJS+STUN。追加設定不要) / "relay"(Firebase中継。P2P不可のネットワーク向け)。Firebase設定時は公開ルーム一覧・プレゼンスにも使用 */
var FB_MODE_KEY = "sid_transport_v1";
function getTransportMode() {
	try {
		if (localStorage.getItem(FB_MODE_KEY) === "p2p") return "p2p";
	} catch {}
	return FB.cfg ? "relay" : "p2p";
}
function getPeerCtor(relay) {
	if (relay && FB.cfg) return FirebasePeer;
	return window.Peer || (FB.cfg ? FirebasePeer : void 0);
}
/** P2Pホスト用: Firebaseに公開ルームを登録（onDisconnectで自動削除・ハートビート更新） */
FB.publish = function(code, info) {
	if (!FB.cfg) return;
	Promise.resolve(FB.ready).then(() => {
		if (!FB.db) return;
		const ref = FB.db.ref("sid/public/" + code);
		ref.set({ ...info, code, maxPlayers: 10, updatedAt: Date.now() }).catch(() => {});
		ref.onDisconnect().remove();
	}).catch(() => {});
};
FB.unpublish = function(code) {
	if (!FB.cfg || !FB.db) return;
	try {
		FB.db.ref("sid/public/" + code).remove();
	} catch {}
};
var FBEmitter = class {
	constructor() {
		this._h = {};
	}
	on(e, f) {
		(this._h[e] = this._h[e] || []).push(f);
		return this;
	}
	emit(e, ...a) {
		(this._h[e] || []).slice().forEach((f) => {
			try {
				f(...a);
			} catch (err) {
				console.error("[Firebase] handler error", e, err, err && err.stack);
			}
		});
	}
};
var FBConn = class extends FBEmitter {
	constructor(peerObj, remoteId) {
		super();
		this.peerObj = peerObj;
		this.peer = remoteId;
		this.open = false;
	}
	send(data) {
		if (this.open) this.peerObj._deliver(this, data);
	}
	close() {
		if (!this.open) return;
		this.open = false;
		this.peerObj._closeConn(this);
		this.emit("close");
	}
};
var FirebasePeer = class extends FBEmitter {
	constructor(id) {
		super();
		this.uid = "u" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + Date.now().toString(36);
		this.destroyed = false;
		this.conns = {};
		this._offs = [];
		this._timers = [];
		this._graceTimers = {};
		this._pending = null;
		this._pendingTimer = null;
		this._lastState = null;
		this._pub = null;
		this.isHost = typeof id === "string" && id.startsWith("SID-");
		this.code = this.isHost ? id.slice(4) : null;
		this.id = id || "g" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
		Promise.resolve(FB.ready).then(() => {
			if (!FB.db) throw new Error("Firebase 未初期化");
			if (this.destroyed) return;
			return this.isHost ? this._startHost() : this.emit("open", this.id);
		}).catch((err) => {
			console.error("[Firebase] peer start failed", err, err && err.stack);
			this.emit("error", { type: "network", message: String(err && err.message || err) });
		});
	}
	_ref(path) {
		return FB.db.ref("sid/rooms/" + this.code + (path ? "/" + path : ""));
	}
	_listen(ref, ev, fn) {
		ref.on(ev, fn);
		this._offs.push(() => ref.off(ev, fn));
	}
	_every(ms, fn) {
		this._timers.push(setInterval(() => {
			try {
				fn();
			} catch (e) {
				console.error(e);
			}
		}, ms));
	}
	async _startHost() {
		const hostRef = this._ref("host");
		const claim = (cur) => !cur || cur.uid === this.uid || Date.now() - (cur.ts || 0) > 45e3 ? {
			uid: this.uid,
			ts: Date.now()
		} : void 0;
		const res = await hostRef.transaction(claim);
		if (!res.committed) {
			this.emit("error", { type: "unavailable-id" });
			return;
		}
		hostRef.onDisconnect().remove();
		this._ref("state").remove();
		this._every(1e4, async () => {
			const r = await hostRef.transaction(claim);
			if (!r.committed) {
				this.emit("error", { type: "host-superseded" });
				return;
			}
			hostRef.onDisconnect().remove();
			if (this._pub) this._publishPublic();
			const ms = await this._ref("members").once("value");
			const now = Date.now();
			ms.forEach((c) => {
				const v = c.val();
				if (v && now - (v.ts || 0) > 45e3) c.ref.remove();
			});
		});
		const mem = this._ref("members");
		this._listen(mem, "child_added", (snap) => {
			const uid = snap.key;
			if (this._graceTimers[uid]) {
				clearTimeout(this._graceTimers[uid]);
				delete this._graceTimers[uid];
			}
			this._ensureConn(uid);
			this._publishPublic();
		});
		this._listen(mem, "child_removed", (snap) => {
			const uid = snap.key;
			this._graceTimers[uid] = setTimeout(() => {
				delete this._graceTimers[uid];
				const c = this.conns[uid];
				if (c) {
					delete this.conns[uid];
					c.open = false;
					c.emit("close");
				}
				this._publishPublic();
			}, 6e3);
		});
		this._listen(this._ref("box/host"), "child_added", (snap) => {
			const v = snap.val();
			snap.ref.remove();
			if (!v || !v.f) return;
			const c = this._ensureConn(v.f);
			try {
				c.emit("data", JSON.parse(v.d));
			} catch (e) {
				console.error("[Firebase] bad packet", e);
			}
		});
		this.emit("open", this.id);
	}
	_ensureConn(uid) {
		let c = this.conns[uid];
		if (c) return c;
		c = new FBConn(this, uid);
		this.conns[uid] = c;
		c.open = true;
		this.emit("connection", c);
		c.emit("open");
		return c;
	}
	setPublic(info) {
		this._pub = info;
		if (!FB.db) return;
		this._publishPublic();
		try {
			FB.db.ref("sid/public/" + this.code).onDisconnect().remove();
		} catch {}
	}
	_publishPublic() {
		if (!this._pub || !FB.db || this.destroyed) return;
		FB.db.ref("sid/public/" + this.code).set({
			...this._pub,
			code: this.code,
			playerCount: 1 + Object.keys(this.conns).length,
			maxPlayers: 10,
			phase: "lobby",
			updatedAt: Date.now()
		}).catch(() => {});
	}
	connect(remote) {
		const code = String(remote).replace(/^SID-/, "");
		this.code = code;
		const conn = new FBConn(this, remote);
		this.hostConn = conn;
		(async () => {
			try {
				await FB.ready;
				const hs = await this._ref("host").once("value");
				if (!hs.val()) {
					this.emit("error", { type: "peer-unavailable" });
					return;
				}
				const me = this._ref("members/" + this.id);
				await me.set({ ts: Date.now() });
				me.onDisconnect().remove();
				this._every(1e4, () => {
					me.set({ ts: Date.now() });
					me.onDisconnect().remove();
				});
				this._listen(this._ref("box/" + this.id), "child_added", (snap) => {
					const v = snap.val();
					snap.ref.remove();
					if (!v) return;
					try {
						conn.emit("data", JSON.parse(v.d));
					} catch (e) {
						console.error("[Firebase] bad packet", e);
					}
				});
				this._listen(this._ref("state"), "value", (snap) => {
					const v = snap.val();
					if (!v) return;
					try {
						conn.emit("data", JSON.parse(v));
					} catch (e) {
						console.error("[Firebase] bad state", e);
					}
				});
				this._listen(this._ref("host"), "value", (snap) => this._onHostValue(!!snap.val()));
				conn.open = true;
				conn.emit("open");
			} catch (e) {
				console.error("[Firebase] connect failed", e, e && e.stack);
				this.emit("error", { type: "network", message: String(e && e.message || e) });
			}
		})();
		return conn;
	}
	_onHostValue(exists) {
		if (this.destroyed) return;
		if (exists) {
			if (this._hostGone) {
				this._hostGone = false;
				clearTimeout(this._lostTimer);
				this.emit("host-changed");
			}
			return;
		}
		if (this._hostGone) return;
		this._hostGone = true;
		const evaluate = async () => {
			if (this.destroyed || !this._hostGone) return;
			try {
				const ms = await this._ref("members").once("value");
				const now = Date.now();
				const ids = [];
				ms.forEach((c) => {
					const v = c.val();
					if (v && now - (v.ts || 0) < 3e4) ids.push(c.key);
				});
				ids.sort();
				this.emit("host-lost", { promote: ids[0] === this.id, candidates: ids });
			} catch (e) {
				console.error(e);
			}
			this._lostTimer = setTimeout(evaluate, 7e3);
		};
		this._lostTimer = setTimeout(evaluate, 2200);
	}
	_deliver(conn, data) {
		if (!FB.db || this.destroyed) return;
		if (this.isHost) {
			if (data && data.kind === "STATE") {
				this._pending = data;
				if (!this._pendingTimer) this._pendingTimer = setTimeout(() => {
					this._pendingTimer = null;
					const d = this._pending;
					this._pending = null;
					if (d) this._ref("state").set(JSON.stringify(d)).catch((e) => console.error(e));
				}, 70);
				return;
			}
			this._ref("box/" + conn.peer).push({ f: "host", d: JSON.stringify(data) }).catch((e) => console.error(e));
		} else this._ref("box/host").push({ f: this.id, d: JSON.stringify(data) }).catch((e) => console.error(e));
	}
	_closeConn(conn) {
		if (this.isHost && this.conns[conn.peer] === conn) delete this.conns[conn.peer];
	}
	reconnect() {}
	destroy() {
		if (this.destroyed) return;
		this.destroyed = true;
		clearTimeout(this._lostTimer);
		clearTimeout(this._pendingTimer);
		Object.values(this._graceTimers).forEach(clearTimeout);
		this._timers.forEach(clearInterval);
		this._offs.forEach((f) => {
			try {
				f();
			} catch {}
		});
		if (!FB.db || !this.code) return;
		const code = this.code;
		const roomRef = FB.db.ref("sid/rooms/" + code);
		const tasks = [];
		if (this.isHost) {
			tasks.push(roomRef.child("host").transaction((cur) => cur && cur.uid === this.uid ? null : void 0));
			tasks.push(FB.db.ref("sid/public/" + code).remove());
		} else tasks.push(roomRef.child("members/" + this.id).remove());
		Promise.all(tasks).then(() => roomRef.once("value")).then((snap) => {
			const v = snap.val() || {};
			if (!v.host && (!v.members || Object.keys(v.members).length === 0)) roomRef.remove();
		}).catch(() => {});
	}
};

var HUD_STORAGE_KEY = "sid_hud_settings_v1";
var KEYBINDS_STORAGE_KEY = "sid_keybinds_v1";

function createDefaultProgression() {
	return {
		matchesPlayed: 0,
		crewWins: 0,
		impostorWins: 0,
		neutralWins: 0,
		totalTasks: 0,
		totalKills: 0,
		correctEjects: 0,
		ghostAssists: 0,
		chatsSent: 0,
		surviveStreak: 0,
		mapsPlayed: [],
		sheriffHits: 0,
		sabotagesFixed: 0,
		fastestCrewWinSec: void 0,
		maxEjectsInMatch: 0,
		firstBodyReports: 0,
		shadowAssassins: 0,
		perfectTaskWins: 0,
		closeCallSaves: 0,
		uniqueCosmeticsUsed: [],
		customFullLoadoutMatches: 0,
		unlockedAchievements: [],
		sandboxUnlockAll: false
	};
}
function loadProgression() {
	try {
		const raw = localStorage.getItem(PROGRESSION_STORAGE_KEY);
		if (!raw) return createDefaultProgression();
		const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
		return {
			...createDefaultProgression(),
			...parsed,
			mapsPlayed: Array.isArray(parsed.mapsPlayed) ? parsed.mapsPlayed : [],
			unlockedAchievements: Array.isArray(parsed.unlockedAchievements) ? parsed.unlockedAchievements : [],
			uniqueCosmeticsUsed: Array.isArray(parsed.uniqueCosmeticsUsed) ? parsed.uniqueCosmeticsUsed : []
		};
	} catch {
		return createDefaultProgression();
	}
}
function saveProgression(data) {
	try {
		localStorage.setItem(PROGRESSION_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
	} catch {}
}
function checkAndUnlockAchievements(data) {
	const newlyUnlocked = [];
	const check = (id, condition) => {
		if (condition && !data.unlockedAchievements.includes(id)) {
			data.unlockedAchievements.push(id);
			newlyUnlocked.push(id);
		}
	};
	check("first_match", data.matchesPlayed >= 1);
	check("crew_win_1", data.crewWins >= 1);
	check("imp_win_1", data.impostorWins >= 1);
	check("neutral_win_1", data.neutralWins >= 1);
	check("task_master", data.totalTasks >= 10);
	check("task_legend", data.totalTasks >= 15);
	check("killer_3", data.totalKills >= 3);
	check("detective_eject", data.correctEjects >= 1);
	check("ghost_helper", data.ghostAssists >= 1);
	check("chat_communicator", data.chatsSent >= 5);
	check("survivor_5", data.matchesPlayed >= 3);
	check("imp_master", data.impostorWins >= 3);
	check("speedrunner", typeof data.fastestCrewWinSec === "number" && data.fastestCrewWinSec <= 180);
	check("great_detective", data.correctEjects >= 5 || (data.maxEjectsInMatch || 0) >= 2);
	check("first_discoverer", (data.firstBodyReports || 0) >= 5);
	check("third_assassin", data.neutralWins >= 3);
	check("shadow_assassin", (data.shadowAssassins || 0) >= 1);
	check("perfect_work", (data.perfectTaskWins || 0) >= 1);
	check("close_call", (data.closeCallSaves || 0) >= 1);
	check("veteran_crew", data.matchesPlayed >= 10);
	check("fashion_leader", (data.uniqueCosmeticsUsed?.length || 0) >= 6 || (data.customFullLoadoutMatches || 0) >= 5);
	return newlyUnlocked;
}
function isCosmeticUnlocked(kind, id, prog) {
	if (prog.sandboxUnlockAll) return true;
	if (kind === "color") switch (id) {
		case "coral": return prog.matchesPlayed >= 1;
		case "gold": return prog.crewWins >= 1;
		case "indigo": return prog.totalTasks >= 5;
		case "crimson_nova": return prog.impostorWins >= 1;
		case "starlight_teal": return prog.ghostAssists >= 1;
		case "nebula_violet": return prog.neutralWins >= 1;
		default: return true;
	}
	if (kind === "hat") switch (id) {
		case "crown": return prog.crewWins >= 2;
		case "devil": return prog.impostorWins >= 1;
		case "ufo": return prog.matchesPlayed >= 2;
		case "captain": return prog.correctEjects >= 1;
		case "crystal": return prog.totalTasks >= 10;
		case "angel_wings": return prog.ghostAssists >= 2;
		case "dragon_horns": return prog.totalKills >= 3;
		case "laurel_wreath": return prog.neutralWins >= 1;
		case "ace_visor": return prog.matchesPlayed >= 3;
		case "nebula_crown": return prog.unlockedAchievements.length >= 5;
		case "cyber_oni": return prog.totalKills >= 5;
		case "star_commander": return prog.totalTasks >= 15;
		default: return true;
	}
	if (kind === "pet") switch (id) {
		case "dog_pet": return prog.matchesPlayed >= 1;
		case "slime": return prog.totalTasks >= 5;
		case "ufo_pet": return prog.correctEjects >= 1;
		case "ghost_pet": return prog.ghostAssists >= 1;
		case "star_dragon": return prog.crewWins + prog.neutralWins >= 2;
		case "quantum_owl": return prog.unlockedAchievements.length >= 4;
		case "crystal_crab": return prog.totalTasks >= 8;
		case "astro_penguin": return prog.matchesPlayed >= 2;
		case "mecha_beetle": return prog.impostorWins >= 2;
		default: return true;
	}
	if (kind === "killEffect") switch (id) {
		case "void": return prog.totalKills >= 2;
		case "thunder": return prog.impostorWins >= 1;
		case "blackhole": return prog.neutralWins >= 1;
		case "stardust": return prog.unlockedAchievements.length >= 6;
		default: return true;
	}
	return true;
}
function formatKeyLabel(code) {
	if (!code) return "-";
	if (code.startsWith("Key")) return code.slice(3);
	if (code.startsWith("Digit")) return code.slice(5);
	if (code === "Space") return "SPACE";
	if (code === "ArrowUp") return "↑";
	if (code === "ArrowDown") return "↓";
	if (code === "ArrowLeft") return "←";
	if (code === "ArrowRight") return "→";
	return code;
}

function loadPublicRooms() {
	try {
		const raw = localStorage.getItem(PUBLIC_ROOMS_STORAGE_KEY);
		if (!raw) return [];
		const list = JSON.parse(raw);
		const now = Date.now();
		return Array.isArray(list) ? list.filter((r) => now - (r.updatedAt || 0) < 36e5) : [];
	} catch {
		return [];
	}
}

function randomId(len = 6) {
	const chars = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
	let out = "";
	for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) out += chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * 32)];
	return out;
}

var POST_WARP_GRACE_SEC = .32;
/**
* [GUARD_07] Runtime Health Guard
* ゲーム起動時・フェーズ遷移時・定期監視時にステート不整合を検証し、安全な状態へ自己修復する。
*/
function runRuntimeHealthCheck(params) {
	const issues = [];
	const { phase, players, bodies, mapDef, assignedTasks, validTaskIds, cooldowns, onRepairCooldowns, quiet } = params;
	try {
		const cdKeys = [
			"killCooldown",
			"sabotageCooldown",
			"abilityCooldown",
			"emergencyCooldown",
			"ventCooldown"
		];
		let cdDirty = false;
		const fixedCd = { ...cooldowns };
		for (const k of cdKeys) {
			const v = cooldowns[k];
			if (!Number.isFinite(v) || v < 0 || v > 300) {
				issues.push({
					code: `COOLDOWN_ANOMALY_${k.toUpperCase()}`,
					severity: "warn",
					message: `クールダウン異常値 (${k}=${String(v)}) を検出し 0 に安全リセットしました`,
					repaired: true
				});
				fixedCd[k] = Math.max(0, Math.min(60, Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0));
				cdDirty = true;
			}
		}
		if (cdDirty && onRepairCooldowns) onRepairCooldowns(fixedCd);
		const deadBodyVictimIds = new Set(bodies.map((b) => b.victimId));
		for (const p of Object.values(players)) {
			if (!Number.isFinite(p.x) || !Number.isFinite(p.y)) {
				p.x = mapDef.emergency.x;
				p.y = mapDef.emergency.y + 64;
				p.floor = mapDef.emergency.floor || 1;
				issues.push({
					code: "PLAYER_COORD_NAN",
					severity: "error",
					message: `プレイヤー ${p.name} (${p.id}) の座標がNaNのため緊急テーブル付近へ復帰しました`,
					repaired: true
				});
			}
			if (p.alive && deadBodyVictimIds.has(p.id) && phase === "playing") issues.push({
				code: "ALIVE_WITH_STALE_BODY",
				severity: "warn",
				message: `生存プレイヤー ${p.name} に対応する残存死体レコードを検知しました`,
				repaired: false
			});
		}
		if (phase === "playing" && assignedTasks.length > 0) {
			const emFloor = mapDef.emergency.floor || 1;
			const hub = mapDef.rooms.find((r) => (r.floor || 1) === emFloor && mapDef.emergency.x >= r.x && mapDef.emergency.x <= r.x + r.w && mapDef.emergency.y >= r.y && mapDef.emergency.y <= r.y + r.h);
			for (const tid of assignedTasks) {
				if (!validTaskIds.has(tid)) issues.push({
					code: "INVALID_TASK_ID",
					severity: "error",
					message: `未知のタスクID "${tid}" が検出されました`,
					repaired: false
				});
				if (hub) {
					const spot = mapDef.taskSpots.find((s) => s.taskId === tid);
					if (spot && (spot.floor || 1) === (hub.floor || 1) && spot.x >= hub.x - 18 && spot.x <= hub.x + hub.w + 18 && spot.y >= hub.y - 18 && spot.y <= hub.y + hub.h + 18) issues.push({
						code: "TASK_IN_SPAWN_EXCLUSION",
						severity: "warn",
						message: `タスク ${tid} がスポーン除外ゾーン内に配置されている可能性を検知しました`,
						repaired: false
					});
				}
			}
		}
		if (!quiet && issues.length > 0) console.warn("[RuntimeHealthGuard] 自己診断レポート:", issues);
		else if (!quiet && phase === "playing") console.info("[RuntimeHealthGuard] OK — ステート・タスク・クールダウン整合性チェック正常", {
			phase,
			mapId: mapDef.id,
			playersCount: Object.keys(players).length,
			assignedTasksCount: assignedTasks.length
		});
	} catch (err) {
		console.error("[RuntimeHealthGuard] 自己診断中に例外を捕捉しました:", err, err instanceof Error ? err.stack : "");
	}
	return issues;
}
/**
* [GUARD_01] 死亡者および本人死体の通報を厳格にブロックするガード関数
*/
function canReportBody(reporter, body, phase) {
	if (!reporter || !reporter.alive || reporter.isSpectator) return false;
	if (phase !== "playing") return false;
	if (body && body.victimId === reporter.id) return false;
	return true;
}
/**
* [GUARD_03] テレポート／階段ギミックの正確な目的地座標を解決する
* targetX / targetY が明示されていない場合は、targetId でペアのギミック座標を参照する。
*/
function resolveTeleportTargetCoords(gimmick, mapDef, currentFloor) {
	const targetFloor = gimmick.targetFloor || currentFloor;
	if (typeof gimmick.targetX === "number" && typeof gimmick.targetY === "number") return {
		x: gimmick.targetX,
		y: gimmick.targetY,
		floor: targetFloor
	};
	if (gimmick.targetId) {
		const paired = mapDef.gimmicks.find((g) => g.id === gimmick.targetId);
		if (paired) return {
			x: paired.x,
			y: paired.y,
			floor: paired.floor || targetFloor
		};
	}
	const rooms = mapDef.rooms.filter((r) => (r.floor || 1) === targetFloor);
	if (rooms.length > 0) {
		const room = rooms[Math.floor(Math.random() * rooms.length)];
		return {
			x: room.x + room.w / 2,
			y: room.y + room.h / 2,
			floor: targetFloor
		};
	}
	return null;
}
/**
* [GUARD_05] "random" 指定を含むマップIDを実際の有効マップIDへ動的解決する
*/
function resolveMapSelection(selectedMapId, maps) {
	const keys = Object.keys(maps);
	if (keys.length === 0) return "starship";
	if (selectedMapId === "random") return keys[Math.floor(Math.random() * keys.length)];
	return maps[selectedMapId] ? selectedMapId : keys[0];
}
// src/game/engine.ts
function isImpostorRole(role) {
	return role === "impostor" || role === "phantom" || role === "madscientist" || role === "viper" || role === "shapeshifter";
}
function isLethalImpostorRole(role) {
	return role === "impostor" || role === "phantom" || role === "viper" || role === "shapeshifter";
}
function isNeutralRole(role) {
	return role === "jester" || role === "jackal" || role === "arsonist" || role === "survivor" || role === "executioner";
}
function isCrewRole(role) {
	return !isImpostorRole(role) && !isNeutralRole(role);
}
function hasTasksRole(role) {
	return isCrewRole(role);
}
function canUseVent(role) {
	return isImpostorRole(role) || role === "engineer" || role === "jackal" || role === "jester";
}
function canUseKillButton(role) {
	return isLethalImpostorRole(role) || role === "sheriff" || role === "jackal" || role === "arsonist";
}
function getPlayerTotalTasks(player, baseTasks) {
	const base = Math.max(1, Number(baseTasks) || 4);
	if (player.totalTasks && player.totalTasks > 0) return player.totalTasks;
	return player.role === "mayor" ? base + 1 : base;
}
function getEffectiveKillCooldown(role, baseCd) {
	if (role === "sheriff") return baseCd + 3;
	if (role === "viper") return baseCd + 5;
	if (role === "jackal") return Math.max(10, baseCd - 2);
	if (role === "arsonist") return 16;
	return baseCd;
}
function isEvilRole(role) {
	return isImpostorRole(role) || role === "jackal" || role === "arsonist";
}
function shuffle(arr) {
	const copy = [...arr];
	for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
		const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
		[copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
	}
	return copy;
}
function assignRoles(playerIds, settings) {
	const ids = shuffle(playerIds);
	const roles = {};
	for (const id of ids) roles[id] = "crewmate";
	if (ids.length === 0) return {
		roles,
		executionerTargetId: null
	};
	const maxImp = ids.length <= 4 ? 1 : ids.length <= 7 ? 2 : 3;
	const impCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(settings.impostors) || 1, maxImp));
	const enabled = settings.enabledRoles || {};
	const specialImpPool = [];
	if (enabled.phantom) specialImpPool.push("phantom");
	if (enabled.viper) specialImpPool.push("viper");
	if (enabled.shapeshifter) specialImpPool.push("shapeshifter");
	const shuffledImpSpecials = shuffle(specialImpPool);
	let idx = 0;
	const firstSpec = shuffledImpSpecials.shift();
	roles[ids[idx++]] = firstSpec && Math.random() < .55 ? firstSpec : "impostor";
	for (let i = 1; i < impCount && idx < ids.length; i++) if (enabled.madscientist && ids.length >= 6 && i === impCount - 1 && Math.random() < .45) roles[ids[idx++]] = "madscientist";
	else {
		const nextSpec = shuffledImpSpecials.shift();
		roles[ids[idx++]] = nextSpec && Math.random() < .65 ? nextSpec : "impostor";
	}
	const maxNeutral = Math.max(0, ids.length - idx - 2);
	const neutralTarget = Math.min(Math.max(0, Number(settings.neutralCount) || 0), maxNeutral);
	const neutralPool = shuffle([
		"jester",
		"jackal",
		"arsonist",
		"survivor",
		"executioner"
	].filter((r) => enabled[r]));
	for (let i = 0; i < neutralTarget && i < neutralPool.length && idx < ids.length; i++) roles[ids[idx++]] = neutralPool[i];
	const crewSpecialPool = shuffle([
		"sheriff",
		"engineer",
		"doctor",
		"detective",
		"radar",
		"mayor",
		"security",
		"tracker",
		"teleporter",
		"psychic"
	].filter((r) => enabled[r]));
	const specialTarget = Math.min(Math.max(0, Number(settings.specialRolesCount) || 0), crewSpecialPool.length, Math.max(0, ids.length - idx));
	for (let i = 0; i < specialTarget && idx < ids.length; i++) roles[ids[idx++]] = crewSpecialPool[i];
	let executionerTargetId = null;
	const execId = ids.find((id) => roles[id] === "executioner");
	if (execId) {
		const crewCandidates = ids.filter((id) => id !== execId && isCrewRole(roles[id]));
		const fallbackCandidates = ids.filter((id) => id !== execId && !isImpostorRole(roles[id]));
		const pool = crewCandidates.length > 0 ? crewCandidates : fallbackCandidates;
		if (pool.length > 0) executionerTargetId = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
		else roles[execId] = "jester";
	}
	return {
		roles,
		executionerTargetId
	};
}
function checkWinCondition(players, settings) {
	const active = Object.values(players).filter((p) => !p.isSpectator);
	if (active.length === 0) return null;
	const aliveCrew = active.filter((p) => p.alive && isCrewRole(p.role));
	const aliveImp = active.filter((p) => p.alive && isImpostorRole(p.role));
	const aliveJackal = active.filter((p) => p.alive && p.role === "jackal");
	const aliveNonImp = active.filter((p) => p.alive && !isImpostorRole(p.role));
	const aliveNonJackal = active.filter((p) => p.alive && p.role !== "jackal");
	if (aliveImp.length === 0 && aliveJackal.length === 0) return {
		winner: "crewmates",
		reason: "潜伏していたすべての人外（インポスター・ジャッカル）を排除しました！"
	};
	const baseTasks = Math.max(1, Number(settings.tasksPerPlayer) || 4);
	if (aliveCrew.length > 0 && aliveCrew.every((p) => (p.tasksDone || 0) >= getPlayerTotalTasks(p, baseTasks))) return {
		winner: "crewmates",
		reason: "生存している全クルーがタスクを100%完了しました！"
	};
	if (aliveImp.length > 0 && aliveImp.length >= aliveNonImp.length && aliveJackal.length === 0) return {
		winner: "impostors",
		reason: "インポスターが生存者の過半数を制圧しました！"
	};
	if (aliveJackal.length > 0 && aliveJackal.length >= aliveNonJackal.length && aliveImp.length === 0) return {
		winner: "jackal",
		reason: "第三陣営・ジャッカルが生き残りを制圧しました！"
	};
	return null;
}
function tallyVotes(votes, players) {
	const counts = {};
	let skipCount = 0;
	for (const [voterId, targetId] of Object.entries(votes)) {
		const voter = players[voterId];
		if (!voter || !voter.alive || voter.isSpectator) continue;
		const weight = voter.role === "mayor" ? 2 : 1;
		if (targetId === "skip") skipCount += weight;
		else if (players[targetId] && players[targetId].alive && !players[targetId].isSpectator) counts[targetId] = (counts[targetId] || 0) + weight;
	}
	let topId = null;
	let topVotes = skipCount;
	let isTie = false;
	for (const [candidateId, count] of Object.entries(counts)) if (count > topVotes) {
		topVotes = count;
		topId = candidateId;
		isTie = false;
	} else if (count === topVotes && count > 0) isTie = true;
	if (isTie || topId === null) return {
		ejectedId: null,
		isTie,
		skipCount
	};
	return {
		ejectedId: topId,
		isTie: false,
		skipCount
	};
}
function isPointInRects(x, y, rects) {
	for (const r of rects) if (x >= r.x && x <= r.x + r.w && y >= r.y && y <= r.y + r.h) return true;
	return false;
}
function isPointInRoom(x, y, room) {
	return x >= room.x && x <= room.x + room.w && y >= room.y && y <= room.y + room.h;
}
function getRoomName(x, y, mapDef, floor = 1) {
	for (const r of mapDef.rooms) if ((r.floor || 1) === floor && x >= r.x && x <= r.x + r.w && y >= r.y && y <= r.y + r.h) return r.name;
	return `${mapDef.hasMultiFloor ? `${floor}F ` : ""}連絡通路`;
}
function getDynamicDoorState(g, matchElapsed) {
	if (g.type !== "auto_door" && g.type !== "shifting_wall") return {
		closed: false,
		warning: false,
		timeRemaining: 0
	};
	const openSec = Math.max(2, g.cycleOpenSec ?? 10);
	const cycleSec = openSec + Math.max(2, g.cycleClosedSec ?? 5);
	const phase = ((matchElapsed + (g.phaseOffsetSec ?? 0)) % cycleSec + cycleSec) % cycleSec;
	const closed = phase >= openSec;
	const timeRemaining = closed ? cycleSec - phase : openSec - phase;
	return {
		closed,
		warning: !closed && timeRemaining <= 2,
		timeRemaining
	};
}
function getActiveDoorBlockers(mapDef, floor, sabotage, lockdownTimers, matchElapsed = 0) {
	const blockers = [];
	if (sabotage?.type === "doors") for (const c of mapDef.corridors) {
		if ((c.floor || 1) !== floor) continue;
		if (c.w > c.h) blockers.push({
			x: c.x + c.w / 2 - 10,
			y: c.y,
			w: 20,
			h: c.h,
			floor,
			doorKind: "sabotage"
		});
		else blockers.push({
			x: c.x,
			y: c.y + c.h / 2 - 10,
			w: c.w,
			h: 20,
			floor,
			doorKind: "sabotage"
		});
	}
	for (const g of mapDef.gimmicks) {
		if ((g.floor || 1) !== floor || !g.doorRect) continue;
		if (g.type === "lockdown_door") {
			if ((lockdownTimers[g.id || g.label] || 0) > 0) blockers.push({
				...g.doorRect,
				floor,
				doorKind: "lockdown"
			});
		} else if (g.type === "auto_door" || g.type === "shifting_wall") {
			if (getDynamicDoorState(g, matchElapsed).closed) blockers.push({
				...g.doorRect,
				floor,
				doorKind: g.type
			});
		}
	}
	return blockers;
}
function canWalk(x, y, mapDef, alive, doorBlockers = [], floor = 1) {
	if (!alive) return x >= 30 && x <= 2050 && y >= 30 && y <= 1310;
	const walkable = [...mapDef.rooms.filter((r) => (r.floor || 1) === floor), ...mapDef.corridors.filter((c) => (c.floor || 1) === floor)];
	const pts = [
		[x, y],
		[x - 14, y],
		[x + 14, y],
		[x, y - 14],
		[x, y + 14]
	];
	for (const [px, py] of pts) if (!isPointInRects(px, py, walkable)) return false;
	for (const obs of mapDef.obstacles) if ((obs.floor || 1) === floor && x + 14 > obs.x && x - 14 < obs.x + obs.w && y + 14 > obs.y && y - 14 < obs.y + obs.h) return false;
	for (const d of doorBlockers) if ((d.floor || 1) === floor && x + 14 > d.x && x - 14 < d.x + d.w && y + 14 > d.y && y - 14 < d.y + d.h) return false;
	return true;
}
function resolveDoorOverlap(x, y, mapDef, doorBlockers, floor = 1) {
	if (doorBlockers.length === 0 || canWalk(x, y, mapDef, true, doorBlockers, floor)) return {
		x,
		y
	};
	for (const r of [
		20,
		34,
		48,
		64,
		82
	]) for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
		const ang = i / 12 * Math.PI * 2;
		const nx = x + Math.cos(ang) * r;
		const ny = y + Math.sin(ang) * r;
		if (canWalk(nx, ny, mapDef, true, doorBlockers, floor)) return {
			x: nx,
			y: ny
		};
	}
	return {
		x,
		y
	};
}
function moveWithSlide(x, y, dx, dy, dt, speed, mapDef, alive, doorBlockers = [], floor = 1) {
	let nx = x;
	let ny = y;
	const stepX = dx * speed * dt;
	const stepY = dy * speed * dt;
	if (canWalk(nx + stepX, ny, mapDef, alive, doorBlockers, floor)) nx += stepX;
	if (canWalk(nx, ny + stepY, mapDef, alive, doorBlockers, floor)) ny += stepY;
	return {
		x: nx,
		y: ny
	};
}
function resolveSafePos(x, y, mapDef, floor = 1) {
	if (canWalk(x, y, mapDef, true, [], floor)) return {
		x,
		y
	};
	for (let r = 24; r <= 240; r += 24) for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
		const ang = i / 12 * Math.PI * 2;
		const nx = x + Math.cos(ang) * r;
		const ny = y + Math.sin(ang) * r;
		if (canWalk(nx, ny, mapDef, true, [], floor)) return {
			x: nx,
			y: ny
		};
	}
	const fallbackRoom = mapDef.rooms.find((r) => (r.floor || 1) === floor) || mapDef.rooms[0];
	return fallbackRoom ? {
		x: fallbackRoom.x + fallbackRoom.w / 2,
		y: fallbackRoom.y + fallbackRoom.h / 2
	} : {
		x,
		y
	};
}
function computeVisionRadius(me, mapDef, sabotage, settings, sandstormActive, steamActive) {
	if (!me.alive || me.isSpectator) return 560;
	let base = mapDef.visionBase || 295;
	if (isImpostorRole(me.role)) base = 410;
	else if (me.role === "jackal") base = 385;
	else if (me.role === "security") base = 335;
	let rad = base * (Number(settings.visionMult) || 1);
	if (sabotage?.type === "lights" && !isImpostorRole(me.role) && me.role !== "jackal") rad *= .44;
	if (sabotage?.type === "gas" && !isImpostorRole(me.role) && me.role !== "jackal") rad *= .62;
	const floor = me.floor || 1;
	if (sandstormActive && isPointInRects(me.x, me.y, mapDef.corridors.filter((c) => (c.floor || 1) === floor)) && !isPointInRects(me.x, me.y, mapDef.rooms.filter((r) => (r.floor || 1) === floor))) rad *= .68;
	for (const g of mapDef.gimmicks) if ((g.floor || 1) === floor && (g.type === "spore_mist" || g.type === "steam_hazard" && steamActive) && g.w && g.h && me.x >= g.x && me.x <= g.x + g.w && me.y >= g.y && me.y <= g.y + g.h) rad *= g.visionMult ?? .72;
	return Math.max(95, Math.round(rad));
}
var staticSegmentsCache = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
function getStaticSightBlockingSegments(mapDef, floor) {
	const cacheKey = `${mapDef.id}_f${floor}`;
	const cached = staticSegmentsCache.get(cacheKey);
	if (cached) return cached;
	const walkable = [...mapDef.rooms.filter((r) => (r.floor || 1) === floor), ...mapDef.corridors.filter((c) => (c.floor || 1) === floor)];
	const xs = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
	const ys = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
	for (const r of walkable) {
		xs.add(r.x);
		xs.add(r.x + r.w);
		ys.add(r.y);
		ys.add(r.y + r.h);
	}
	const sortedX = Array.from(xs).sort((a, b) => a - b);
	const sortedY = Array.from(ys).sort((a, b) => a - b);
	const segs = [];
	for (const y of sortedY) {
		let runStart = null;
		for (let i = 0; i < sortedX.length - 1; i++) {
			const x1 = sortedX[i];
			const x2 = sortedX[i + 1];
			if (x2 - x1 < .5) continue;
			const mx = (x1 + x2) * .5;
			if (isPointInRects(mx, y - .5, walkable) !== isPointInRects(mx, y + .5, walkable)) {
				if (runStart === null) runStart = x1;
			} else if (runStart !== null) {
				segs.push({
					x1: runStart,
					y1: y,
					x2: x1,
					y2: y
				});
				runStart = null;
			}
		}
		if (runStart !== null && sortedX.length > 0) segs.push({
			x1: runStart,
			y1: y,
			x2: sortedX[sortedX.length - 1],
			y2: y
		});
	}
	for (const x of sortedX) {
		let runStart = null;
		for (let i = 0; i < sortedY.length - 1; i++) {
			const y1 = sortedY[i];
			const y2 = sortedY[i + 1];
			if (y2 - y1 < .5) continue;
			const my = (y1 + y2) * .5;
			if (isPointInRects(x - .5, my, walkable) !== isPointInRects(x + .5, my, walkable)) {
				if (runStart === null) runStart = y1;
			} else if (runStart !== null) {
				segs.push({
					x1: x,
					y1: runStart,
					x2: x,
					y2: y1
				});
				runStart = null;
			}
		}
		if (runStart !== null && sortedY.length > 0) segs.push({
			x1: x,
			y1: runStart,
			x2: x,
			y2: sortedY[sortedY.length - 1]
		});
	}
	for (const obs of mapDef.obstacles) if ((obs.floor || 1) === floor && obs.blocksSight) segs.push({
		x1: obs.x,
		y1: obs.y,
		x2: obs.x + obs.w,
		y2: obs.y
	}, {
		x1: obs.x + obs.w,
		y1: obs.y,
		x2: obs.x + obs.w,
		y2: obs.y + obs.h
	}, {
		x1: obs.x + obs.w,
		y1: obs.y + obs.h,
		x2: obs.x,
		y2: obs.y + obs.h
	}, {
		x1: obs.x,
		y1: obs.y + obs.h,
		x2: obs.x,
		y2: obs.y
	});
	staticSegmentsCache.set(cacheKey, segs);
	return segs;
}
function getSightBlockingSegments(mapDef, floor, doorBlockers) {
	const base = getStaticSightBlockingSegments(mapDef, floor);
	if (doorBlockers.length === 0) return base;
	const segs = [...base];
	for (const d of doorBlockers) if ((d.floor || 1) === floor) segs.push({
		x1: d.x,
		y1: d.y,
		x2: d.x + d.w,
		y2: d.y
	}, {
		x1: d.x + d.w,
		y1: d.y,
		x2: d.x + d.w,
		y2: d.y + d.h
	}, {
		x1: d.x + d.w,
		y1: d.y + d.h,
		x2: d.x,
		y2: d.y + d.h
	}, {
		x1: d.x,
		y1: d.y + d.h,
		x2: d.x,
		y2: d.y
	});
	return segs;
}
function rayIntersectSegment(ox, oy, dx, dy, seg, maxDist) {
	const sx = seg.x2 - seg.x1;
	const sy = seg.y2 - seg.y1;
	const denom = dx * sy - dy * sx;
	if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-8) return maxDist;
	const qx = seg.x1 - ox;
	const qy = seg.y1 - oy;
	const t = (qx * sy - qy * sx) / denom;
	if (t < 0 || t > maxDist) return maxDist;
	const u = (qx * dy - qy * dx) / denom;
	if (u < -1e-4 || u > 1.0001) return maxDist;
	return t;
}
function computeVisibilityPolygon(ox, oy, radius, segments) {
	const bound = radius + 60;
	const minX = ox - bound;
	const maxX = ox + bound;
	const minY = oy - bound;
	const maxY = oy + bound;
	const nearby = [];
	const angles = [];
	for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) {
		const s = segments[i];
		if (Math.max(s.x1, s.x2) < minX || Math.min(s.x1, s.x2) > maxX || Math.max(s.y1, s.y2) < minY || Math.min(s.y1, s.y2) > maxY) continue;
		nearby.push(s);
		const a1 = Math.atan2(s.y1 - oy, s.x1 - ox);
		const a2 = Math.atan2(s.y2 - oy, s.x2 - ox);
		angles.push(a1 - 6e-4, a1, a1 + 6e-4, a2 - 6e-4, a2, a2 + 6e-4);
	}
	for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) angles.push(-Math.PI + i / 60 * Math.PI * 2);
	const normalized = angles.map((a) => {
		let v = a;
		while (v <= -Math.PI) v += Math.PI * 2;
		while (v > Math.PI) v -= Math.PI * 2;
		return v;
	});
	normalized.sort((a, b) => a - b);
	const unique = [];
	for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) if (unique.length === 0 || normalized[i] - unique[unique.length - 1] > 15e-5) unique.push(normalized[i]);
	const pts = [];
	for (let i = 0; i < unique.length; i++) {
		const ang = unique[i];
		const dx = Math.cos(ang);
		const dy = Math.sin(ang);
		let minT = radius;
		for (let j = 0; j < nearby.length; j++) {
			const t = rayIntersectSegment(ox, oy, dx, dy, nearby[j], minT);
			if (t < minT) minT = t;
		}
		pts.push({
			x: ox + dx * minT,
			y: oy + dy * minT
		});
	}
	return pts;
}
function hasLineOfSight(x1, y1, x2, y2, segments, maxDist = Infinity) {
	const dx = x2 - x1;
	const dy = y2 - y1;
	const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
	if (dist > maxDist) return false;
	if (dist < 1) return true;
	const ux = dx / dist;
	const uy = dy / dist;
	const minX = Math.min(x1, x2);
	const maxX = Math.max(x1, x2);
	const minY = Math.min(y1, y2);
	const maxY = Math.max(y1, y2);
	for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) {
		const s = segments[i];
		if (Math.max(s.x1, s.x2) < minX || Math.min(s.x1, s.x2) > maxX || Math.max(s.y1, s.y2) < minY || Math.min(s.y1, s.y2) > maxY) continue;
		if (rayIntersectSegment(x1, y1, ux, uy, s, dist - 2) < dist - 2) return false;
	}
	return true;
}
function getSpawnHubRoom(mapDef) {
	const emFloor = mapDef.emergency.floor || 1;
	return mapDef.rooms.find((r) => (r.floor || 1) === emFloor && mapDef.emergency.x >= r.x && mapDef.emergency.x <= r.x + r.w && mapDef.emergency.y >= r.y && mapDef.emergency.y <= r.y + r.h) || mapDef.rooms.find((r) => (r.floor || 1) === emFloor) || mapDef.rooms[0];
}
/**
* [GUARD_04] スポーン地点（緊急ボタンのある中央部屋）内・近傍かを判定する
*/
function isNearSpawnHub(spot, hub, margin = 18) {
	if (!hub) return false;
	if ((spot.floor || 1) !== (hub.floor || 1)) return false;
	return spot.x >= hub.x - margin && spot.x <= hub.x + hub.w + margin && spot.y >= hub.y - margin && spot.y <= hub.y + hub.h + margin;
}
/**
* 全員を特定の1つの部屋（緊急ボタン周囲のスポーンハブ）に整列配置する
* キャラ同士が重ならないよう放射状に安全座標を割り振る
*/
function getSpawnPosition(mapDef, index, total) {
	const hub = getSpawnHubRoom(mapDef);
	const floor = hub?.floor || mapDef.emergency.floor || 1;
	const ang = index / Math.max(1, total) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
	const cx = hub ? hub.x + hub.w / 2 : mapDef.emergency.x;
	const cy = hub ? hub.y + hub.h / 2 : mapDef.emergency.y;
	const ex = mapDef.emergency.x;
	const ey = mapDef.emergency.y;
	for (const r of [
		92,
		108,
		126,
		82,
		64,
		48
	]) {
		const nx = ex + Math.cos(ang) * r;
		const ny = ey + Math.sin(ang) * r;
		if ((!hub || isPointInRoom(nx, ny, hub)) && canWalk(nx, ny, mapDef, true, [], floor)) return {
			x: nx,
			y: ny,
			floor
		};
	}
	for (const r of [
		50,
		82,
		110,
		32
	]) {
		const nx = cx + Math.cos(ang) * r;
		const ny = cy + Math.sin(ang) * r;
		if ((!hub || isPointInRoom(nx, ny, hub)) && canWalk(nx, ny, mapDef, true, [], floor)) return {
			x: nx,
			y: ny,
			floor
		};
	}
	if (hub) for (let t = 0; t < 24; t++) {
		const a2 = ang + t * Math.PI / 12;
		const r2 = 36 + t % 4 * 26;
		const nx = cx + Math.cos(a2) * r2;
		const ny = cy + Math.sin(a2) * r2;
		if (isPointInRoom(nx, ny, hub) && canWalk(nx, ny, mapDef, true, [], floor) && Math.hypot(nx - ex, ny - ey) > 78) return {
			x: nx,
			y: ny,
			floor
		};
	}
	const safe = resolveSafePos(cx + Math.cos(ang) * 60, cy + Math.sin(ang) * 60, mapDef, floor);
	return {
		x: safe.x,
		y: safe.y,
		floor
	};
}
/**
* [GUARD_04] 初期スポーン部屋のタスクスポットを厳格に除外し、他ルームへ均等分散割り当てする
*/
function assignTasks(mapDef, count) {
	const hub = getSpawnHubRoom(mapDef);
	const filtered = mapDef.taskSpots.filter((s) => !isNearSpawnHub(s, hub, 18));
	const pool = filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : mapDef.taskSpots;
	const byRoom = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
	for (const s of shuffle(pool)) {
		const rName = getRoomName(s.x, s.y, mapDef, s.floor || 1);
		const list = byRoom.get(rName) || [];
		list.push(s);
		byRoom.set(rName, list);
	}
	const roomKeys = shuffle(Array.from(byRoom.keys()));
	const selected = [];
	const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
	let round = 0;
	while (selected.length < count && roomKeys.length > 0 && round < 8) {
		let addedInRound = false;
		for (const rk of roomKeys) {
			if (selected.length >= count) break;
			const list = byRoom.get(rk);
			if (!list) continue;
			while (list.length > 0) {
				const spot = list.shift();
				if (!used.has(spot.taskId)) {
					used.add(spot.taskId);
					selected.push(spot.taskId);
					addedInRound = true;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		if (!addedInRound) break;
		round++;
	}
	if (selected.length < count) for (const spot of shuffle(pool)) {
		if (selected.length >= count) break;
		if (!used.has(spot.taskId)) {
			used.add(spot.taskId);
			selected.push(spot.taskId);
		}
	}
	return selected;
}
function getGimmickKey(g, idx) {
	return g.id || `${g.type}_${g.floor || 1}_${Math.round(g.x)}_${Math.round(g.y)}${idx === void 0 ? "" : `_${idx}`}`;
}
function getUseActionState(params) {
	const { me, mapDef, sabotage, myTasks, completedTasks, cameraWatchTimer, emergencyCooldown, emergencyUsesLeft, gimmickCooldowns } = params;
	if (!me || me.isSpectator) return {
		kind: "none",
		label: "⚡ 使用 / 修理",
		enabled: false
	};
	if (cameraWatchTimer > 0) return {
		kind: "close_camera",
		label: "📹 カメラ終了",
		enabled: true
	};
	if (me.inVent) return {
		kind: "none",
		label: "⚡ 使用 / 修理",
		enabled: false
	};
	const floor = me.floor || 1;
	const stairsNearby = mapDef.gimmicks.map((g, idx) => ({
		g,
		idx,
		dist: Math.hypot(g.x - me.x, g.y - me.y)
	})).filter((item) => item.g.type === "stairs" && (item.g.floor || 1) === floor && item.dist <= 68).sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist);
	if (stairsNearby.length > 0) {
		const item = stairsNearby[0];
		const cd = gimmickCooldowns[getGimmickKey(item.g, item.idx)] || 0;
		return {
			kind: "stairs",
			label: cd > 0 ? `🪜 (${Math.ceil(cd)}s)` : item.g.label || "🪜 階層移動",
			enabled: cd <= 0,
			gimmick: item.g
		};
	}
	if (sabotage && sabotage.type !== "doors" && me.alive) {
		const fix = mapDef.sabotageFix[sabotage.type];
		if (fix && (fix.floor || 1) === floor && Math.hypot(fix.x - me.x, fix.y - me.y) <= 84) return {
			kind: "sabotage",
			label: `🚨 ${fix.label || "緊急修理"}`,
			enabled: true,
			sabotageType: sabotage.type
		};
	}
	if (hasTasksRole(me.role)) {
		const nearbyTasks = [];
		for (const spot of mapDef.taskSpots) {
			if ((spot.floor || 1) !== floor || !myTasks.includes(spot.taskId) || completedTasks[spot.taskId]) continue;
			const dist = Math.hypot(spot.x - me.x, spot.y - me.y);
			if (dist <= 82) nearbyTasks.push({
				spot,
				dist
			});
		}
		if (nearbyTasks.length > 0) {
			nearbyTasks.sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist);
			const spot = nearbyTasks[0].spot;
			const task = TASKS.find((t) => t.id === spot.taskId);
			if (task) return {
				kind: "task",
				label: `🔧 ${task.name}`,
				enabled: true,
				task,
				taskSpot: spot
			};
		}
	}
	if (me.alive) {
		const nearbyGimmicks = mapDef.gimmicks.map((g, idx) => ({
			g,
			idx,
			dist: Math.hypot(g.x - me.x, g.y - me.y)
		})).filter((item) => INTERACTIVE_GIMMICKS.has(item.g.type) && (item.g.floor || 1) === floor && item.dist <= 80).sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist);
		if (nearbyGimmicks.length > 0) {
			const { g, idx } = nearbyGimmicks[0];
			const cd = gimmickCooldowns[getGimmickKey(g, idx)] || 0;
			return {
				kind: "gimmick",
				label: cd > 0 ? `${g.icon || "✨"} (${Math.ceil(cd)}s)` : `${g.icon || "✨"} ${g.label}`,
				enabled: cd <= 0,
				gimmick: g
			};
		}
		if ((mapDef.emergency.floor || 1) === floor && Math.hypot(mapDef.emergency.x - me.x, mapDef.emergency.y - me.y) <= 76) {
			const ok = !sabotage && emergencyCooldown <= 0 && emergencyUsesLeft > 0;
			return {
				kind: "emergency",
				label: emergencyCooldown > 0 ? `🔔 (${Math.ceil(emergencyCooldown)}s)` : emergencyUsesLeft <= 0 ? "🔔 回数切れ" : sabotage ? "🔔 妨害中は不可" : "🔔 緊急会議",
				enabled: ok
			};
		}
	}
	return {
		kind: "none",
		label: "⚡ 使用 / 修理",
		enabled: false
	};
}
function createDoorLogEntry(player, location, elapsedSec) {
	const defColor = PLAYER_COLORS.find((c) => c.id === player.color) || PLAYER_COLORS[0];
	const colorHex = player.disguisedAs ? (PLAYER_COLORS.find((c) => c.id === player.disguisedAs?.color) || defColor).hex : defColor.hex;
	const mins = Math.floor(elapsedSec / 60);
	const secs = Math.floor(elapsedSec % 60);
	return {
		id: `dl_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
		playerName: player.disguisedAs ? player.disguisedAs.name : player.name,
		colorHex,
		location,
		timeText: `${String(mins).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(secs).padStart(2, "0")}`
	};
}

	const [joyKnob, setJoyKnob] = (0, import_react.useState)({

	});

	const draggingRef = (0, import_react.useRef)(false);
	if (!me) return null;
	const roleDef = ROLES[me.role] || ROLES.crewmate;
	const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round(taskCompletedCount / Math.max(1, taskTotalCount) * 100));

		const el = joyRef.current;
		if (!el) return;
		const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
		const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
		const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
		const maxR = rect.width * .38;
		const dx = clientX - cx;
		const dy = clientY - cy;
		const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
		if (len < 4) {
			setJoyKnob({
				x: 0,
				y: 0
			});
			onJoystickChange(0, 0);
			return;
		}
		const clampR = Math.min(maxR, len);
		const ux = dx / len;
		const uy = dy / len;
		setJoyKnob({
			x: ux * clampR,
			y: uy * clampR
		});
		onJoystickChange(ux, uy);
	};
	const resetJoystick = () => {
		draggingRef.current = false;

			x: 0,

		});

function drawHat(ctx, hatId, colorHex, nowMs = 0) {
	if (!hatId || hatId === "none") return;
	ctx.save();
	ctx.lineJoin = "round";
	ctx.lineCap = "round";
	ctx.strokeStyle = "#090d16";
	ctx.lineWidth = 2.1;
	const pulse = Math.sin(nowMs * .005);
	const bob = Math.sin(nowMs * .004) * 1.4;
	switch (hatId) {
		case "crown": {
			const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -37, 0, -21);
			grad.addColorStop(0, "#fef08a");
			grad.addColorStop(.55, "#facc15");
			grad.addColorStop(1, "#ca8a04");
			ctx.fillStyle = grad;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(-12, -21);
			ctx.lineTo(-13, -34);
			ctx.lineTo(-5, -27);
			ctx.lineTo(0, -37);
			ctx.lineTo(5, -27);
			ctx.lineTo(13, -34);
			ctx.lineTo(12, -21);
			ctx.closePath();
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#991b1b";
			ctx.fillRect(-10.5, -24.5, 21, 3.2);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(0, -28.5, 2.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#f43f5e";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(-7.5, -27.5, 1.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.arc(7.5, -27.5, 1.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#fef9c3";
			for (const [tx, ty] of [
				[-13, -34],
				[0, -37],
				[13, -34]
			]) {
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.arc(tx, ty, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
				ctx.fill();
			}
			break;
		}
		case "cat":
			ctx.fillStyle = colorHex;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(-13, -18);
			ctx.lineTo(-10, -35);
			ctx.lineTo(-1, -22);
			ctx.closePath();
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();

function getHatPreviewUrl(hatId, colorHex = "#38bdf8") {
	if (typeof document === "undefined") return "";
	const key = `${hatId}_${colorHex}`;
	const cached = hatPreviewCache.get(key);
	if (cached) return cached;
	const c = document.createElement("canvas");
	c.width = 64;
	c.height = 64;
	const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return "";
	const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(32, 30, 4, 32, 32, 30);
	bg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)");
	bg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0)");
	ctx.fillStyle = bg;
	ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
	if (hatId === "none") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#64748b";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(32, 32, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(21, 43);
		ctx.lineTo(43, 21);
		ctx.stroke();
	} else {
		ctx.save();
		ctx.translate(32, 62);
		ctx.scale(1.32, 1.32);
		drawHat(ctx, hatId, colorHex, 0);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	const url = c.toDataURL("image/png");
	hatPreviewCache.set(key, url);
	return url;
}
function drawPet(ctx, x, y, petId, colorId, facing = 1, isMoving = false, nowMs = 0) {

	const hop = isMoving ? Math.abs(Math.sin(nowMs * .015)) * 4.2 : Math.sin(nowMs * .005) * 1.6;
