function getPetPreviewUrl(petId, colorId = "cyan") {
	if (typeof document === "undefined") return "";
	const key = `${petId}_${petId === "mini_crew" ? colorId : "std"}`;
	const cached = petPreviewCache.get(key);
	if (cached) return cached;
	const c = document.createElement("canvas");
	c.width = 64;
	c.height = 64;
	const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return "";
	const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 4, 32, 32, 30);
	bg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.16)");
	bg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0)");
	ctx.fillStyle = bg;
	ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
	if (petId === "none") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#64748b";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(32, 32, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(21, 43);
		ctx.lineTo(43, 21);
		ctx.stroke();
	} else {
		ctx.save();
		ctx.translate(32, 36);
		ctx.scale(1.55, 1.55);
		drawPet(ctx, 0, 0, petId, colorId, 1, false, 0);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	const url = c.toDataURL("image/png");
	petPreviewCache.set(key, url);
	return url;
}
function drawKillEffectBurst(ctx, burst, nowMs) {
	const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (nowMs - burst.startedAt) / burst.durationMs));
	if (t >= 1) return;
	const alpha = 1 - t;
	ctx.save();
	ctx.translate(burst.x, burst.y);
	ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
	if (burst.effectId === "glitch") {
		for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
			const a = i / 16 * Math.PI * 2 + i % 2 * .4;
			const d = 12 + t * (45 + i % 4 * 14);
			ctx.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? "#e879f9" : i % 3 === 1 ? "#22d3ee" : burst.colorHex;
			ctx.fillRect(Math.cos(a) * d - 4, Math.sin(a) * d - 4, 8 * alpha + 2, 8 * alpha + 2);
		}
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#f0abfc";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
		ctx.strokeRect(-22 - t * 20, -22 - t * 20, 44 + t * 40, 44 + t * 40);
	} else if (burst.effectId === "supernova") {
		const rad = 16 + t * 72;
		const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 2, 0, 0, rad);
		g.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
		g.addColorStop(.45, "#fbbf24");
		g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(249, 115, 22, 0)");
		ctx.fillStyle = g;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, 0, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	} else if (burst.effectId === "freeze") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#bae6fd";
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.72)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2;
		for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
			const a = i / 12 * Math.PI * 2;
			const d = 10 + t * 54;
			ctx.save();
			ctx.translate(Math.cos(a) * d, Math.sin(a) * d);
			ctx.rotate(a + t * 3);
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(0, -8);
			ctx.lineTo(5, 0);
			ctx.lineTo(0, 8);
			ctx.lineTo(-5, 0);
			ctx.closePath();
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.restore();
		}
	} else if (burst.effectId === "void" || burst.effectId === "blackhole") {
		const rad = Math.max(4, 58 * (1 - t * .65));
		ctx.fillStyle = "#020617";
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#818cf8";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, 0, rad * .55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#c084fc";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
		for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
			const start = t * 9 + i * Math.PI * 2 / 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(0, 0, rad, start, start + 1.4);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	} else if (burst.effectId === "thunder") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#22d3ee";
		ctx.lineWidth = 4;
		for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
			const a = i / 4 * Math.PI * 2 + .3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
			ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a + .25) * (18 + t * 20), Math.sin(a + .25) * (18 + t * 20));
			ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a - .15) * (38 + t * 42), Math.sin(a - .15) * (38 + t * 42));
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	} else if (burst.effectId === "stardust") for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
		const a = i / 14 * Math.PI * 2 + t * 2.4;
		const d = 8 + t * 62;
		ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? "#fde047" : "#38bdf8";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(Math.cos(a) * d, Math.sin(a) * d, 4.5 * alpha + 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	}
	else {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#f43f5e";
		ctx.lineWidth = 5 * alpha + 1;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(-30 - t * 18, -26 - t * 18);
		ctx.lineTo(30 + t * 18, 26 + t * 18);
		ctx.moveTo(30 + t * 18, -26 - t * 18);
		ctx.lineTo(-30 - t * 18, 26 + t * 18);
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	ctx.restore();
}
function drawSkinOverlay(ctx, skin, nowMs) {
	if (!skin || skin === "standard") return;
	ctx.save();
	if (skin === "captain") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#713f12";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.roundRect(-14, -7, 8, 4.5, 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = "#fef08a";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(5, 1, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4444";
		ctx.fillRect(-3, 2, 7, 2.5);
	} else if (skin === "medic") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.9)";
		ctx.fillRect(-12, -2, 24, 9);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4444";
		ctx.fillRect(-2, 0, 5, 5);
		ctx.fillRect(-3.5, 1.5, 8, 2);
	} else if (skin === "cyber") {
		const glow = .55 + .4 * Math.sin(nowMs * .008);
		ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(34, 211, 238, ${glow})`;
		ctx.lineWidth = 2;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(-11, -3);
		ctx.lineTo(-4, 4);
		ctx.lineTo(10, 4);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(232, 121, 249, ${glow})`;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(-6, 8, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.arc(6, 8, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	} else if (skin === "stealth") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#090d16";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3.2;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(-12, -4);
		ctx.lineTo(12, 6);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
		ctx.fillRect(-13, 3, 26, 4);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
		ctx.fillRect(4, 3.8, 4, 2.4);
	} else if (skin === "engineer") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#f59e0b";
		ctx.fillRect(-13, 0, 26, 7);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#fef08a";
		ctx.fillRect(-13, 2, 26, 2);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
		ctx.fillRect(-10, 5, 7, 5);
	} else if (skin === "royal") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#7e22ce";
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#facc15";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(-14, -4);
		ctx.lineTo(-22, 14);
		ctx.lineTo(-10, 14);
		ctx.closePath();
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, -1, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	} else if (skin === "hazard") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
		ctx.fillRect(-13, 1, 26, 6);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#090d16";
		for (let sx = -11; sx < 11; sx += 6) ctx.fillRect(sx, 1, 3, 6);
	}
	ctx.restore();
}
function drawPlayer(ctx, x, y, colorId, hatId, facing = 1, alive = true, isGhost = false, alpha = 1, shielded = false, nowMs = 0, petId, skin = "standard", petOverride) {
	if (petId && petId !== "none" && alive && !isGhost) drawPet(ctx, petOverride ? petOverride.x : x - facing * 26, petOverride ? petOverride.y : y + 12, petId, colorId, facing, false, nowMs);
	const cDef = PLAYER_COLORS.find((c) => c.id === colorId) || PLAYER_COLORS[0];
	ctx.save();
	ctx.translate(x, y);
	ctx.globalAlpha = isGhost ? .45 : alpha;
	if (shielded && alive) {
		ctx.save();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.85)";
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, -4, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.restore();
	}
	if (!alive && !isGhost) {
		ctx.fillStyle = cDef.hex;
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.roundRect(-18, -4, 34, 22, 10);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = "#f8fafc";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.rect(-3, -15, 7, 13);
		ctx.arc(-2, -16, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.arc(4, -16, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.restore();
		return;
	}
	ctx.scale(facing, 1);
	if (!isGhost) {
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.ellipse(0, 22, 17, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	}
	ctx.fillStyle = cDef.dark;
	ctx.strokeStyle = "#090d16";
	ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.roundRect(-21, -8, 10, 22, 5);
	ctx.fill();
	ctx.stroke();
	ctx.fillStyle = cDef.hex;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.roundRect(-14, -22, 28, 36, 14);
	ctx.fill();
	ctx.stroke();
	drawSkinOverlay(ctx, skin, nowMs);
	if (!isGhost) {
		ctx.fillStyle = cDef.hex;
		ctx.fillRect(-12, 10, 9, 11);
		ctx.strokeRect(-12, 10, 9, 11);
		ctx.fillRect(3, 10, 9, 11);
		ctx.strokeRect(3, 10, 9, 11);
	}
	ctx.fillStyle = "#bae6fd";
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.roundRect(-2, -14, 18, 11, 6);
	ctx.fill();
	ctx.stroke();
	ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.ellipse(8, -11, 5, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
	ctx.fill();
	if (hatId && hatId !== "none") drawHat(ctx, hatId, cDef.hex, nowMs);
	ctx.restore();
}
/**
* 環境融合型タスク設備描画: 単なる黄色い丸ではなく、タスク種別に応じた宇宙船内の計器・端末・タンク・配電盤として描画
*/
function drawTaskFixture(ctx, x, y, taskType, taskName, isNearby, nowMs) {
	const pulse = .5 + .5 * Math.sin(nowMs * .008);
	const fastBlink = .5 + .5 * Math.sin(nowMs * .014);
	ctx.save();
	ctx.translate(x, y);
	ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1222";
	ctx.strokeStyle = isNearby ? `rgba(52, 211, 153, ${.75 + .25 * fastBlink})` : `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${.28 + .22 * pulse})`;
	ctx.lineWidth = isNearby ? 2.8 : 1.6;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.roundRect(-22, -19, 44, 38, 7);
	ctx.fill();
	ctx.stroke();
	ctx.fillStyle = isNearby ? "#6ee7b7" : "#475569";
	for (const [rx, ry] of [
		[-18, -15],
		[18, -15],
		[-18, 15],
		[18, 15]
	]) {
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(rx, ry, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	}
	if (isNearby) {
		const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 8, 0, 0, 38 + pulse * 6);
		aura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${.34 + .22 * pulse})`);
		aura.addColorStop(.65, `rgba(52, 211, 153, ${.2 + .16 * fastBlink})`);
		aura.addColorStop(1, "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0)");
		ctx.fillStyle = aura;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, 0, 38 + pulse * 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${.55 + .45 * pulse})`;
		ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, 0, 29 + pulse * 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	if (taskType === "wires" || taskType === "circuit_puzzle") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
		ctx.fillRect(-14, -12, 28, 24);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#f43f5e";
		ctx.fillRect(-11, -8, 6, 4);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
		ctx.fillRect(-11, -1, 6, 4);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
		ctx.fillRect(-11, 6, 6, 4);
		ctx.strokeStyle = isNearby ? "#34d399" : "#fbbf24";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(-5, -6);
		ctx.lineTo(10, 7);
		ctx.moveTo(-5, 1);
		ctx.lineTo(10, -5);
		ctx.stroke();
	} else if (taskType === "hold_gauge" || taskType === "fuel_pump" || taskType === "pipe_rotate" || taskType === "valve_spin") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, 0, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.strokeStyle = isNearby ? "#34d399" : "#38bdf8";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, 0, 10, -Math.PI * .75, Math.PI * .4);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#fde047";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
		ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(nowMs * .004) * 7, Math.sin(nowMs * .004) * 7);
		ctx.stroke();
	} else if (taskType === "sample_scan" || taskType === "temp_balance" || taskType === "crystal_tune") {
		ctx.fillStyle = isNearby ? "rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45)" : "rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.22)";
		ctx.strokeStyle = isNearby ? "#6ee7b7" : "#34d399";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
		for (const vx of [
			-8,
			0,
			8
		]) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(vx - 3, -10, 6, 20, 3);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	} else if (taskType === "asteroid" || taskType === "nav_align" || taskType === "star_constellation" || taskType === "rhythm_sync") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = isNearby ? "#67e8f9" : "#38bdf8";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(0, 0, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(-12, 0);
		ctx.lineTo(12, 0);
		ctx.moveTo(0, -12);
		ctx.lineTo(0, 12);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = isNearby ? "#34d399" : "#fde047";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(4, -3, 2.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	} else {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
		ctx.fillRect(-14, -11, 28, 18);
		ctx.fillStyle = isNearby ? `rgba(34, 211, 238, ${.58 + .34 * pulse})` : `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${.26 + .18 * pulse})`;
		ctx.fillRect(-11, -8, 22, 12);
		ctx.fillStyle = isNearby ? "#a7f3d0" : "#bae6fd";
		ctx.fillRect(-8, -5, 11, 2);
		ctx.fillRect(-8, -1, 15, 2);
		ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
		ctx.fillRect(-11, 9, 22, 4);
	}
	ctx.fillStyle = isNearby ? fastBlink > .5 ? "#34d399" : "#38bdf8" : pulse > .5 ? "#fde047" : "#f59e0b";
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.arc(15, -13, isNearby ? 3.5 : 2.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
	ctx.fill();
	if (isNearby) {
		ctx.font = "900 10px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillStyle = "#a7f3d0";
		ctx.fillText(`⚡ ${taskName}`, 0, -25);
	}
	ctx.restore();
}
function getFloorBounds(mapDef, floor) {
	let minX = 2e3;
	let minY = 1300;
	let maxX = 0;
	let maxY = 0;
	const rects = [...mapDef.rooms.filter((r) => (r.floor || 1) === floor), ...mapDef.corridors.filter((c) => (c.floor || 1) === floor)];
	for (const r of rects) {
		minX = Math.min(minX, r.x);
		minY = Math.min(minY, r.y);
		maxX = Math.max(maxX, r.x + r.w);
		maxY = Math.max(maxY, r.y + r.h);
	}
	if (rects.length === 0) return {
		minX: 120,
		minY: 120,
		maxX: 1920,
		maxY: 1200,
		cx: 1020,
		cy: 660
	};
	return {
		minX,
		minY,
		maxX,
		maxY,
		cx: (minX + maxX) / 2,
		cy: (minY + maxY) / 2
	};
}
function drawExteriorDetails(ctx, mapDef, floor) {
	const b = getFloorBounds(mapDef, floor);
	const theme = mapDef.exteriorTheme || "space";
	ctx.save();
	if (theme === "space" || theme === "moon" || theme === "cyber" || theme === "clouds") {
		const panels = [
			{
				x: Math.max(24, b.minX - 108),
				y: b.cy - 250,
				w: 84,
				h: 170
			},
			{
				x: Math.max(24, b.minX - 108),
				y: b.cy + 80,
				w: 84,
				h: 170
			},
			{
				x: Math.min(1980, b.maxX + 24),
				y: b.cy - 250,
				w: 84,
				h: 170
			},
			{
				x: Math.min(1980, b.maxX + 24),
				y: b.cy + 80,
				w: 84,
				h: 170
			}
		];
		for (const p of panels) {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#0c4a6e";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h, 6);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(125,211,252,0.28)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 1;
			for (let gx = p.x + 18; gx < p.x + p.w; gx += 18) {
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(gx, p.y);
				ctx.lineTo(gx, p.y + p.h);
				ctx.stroke();
			}
			for (let gy = p.y + 24; gy < p.y + p.h; gy += 24) {
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(p.x, gy);
				ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w, gy);
				ctx.stroke();
			}
			ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
			ctx.fillRect(p.x < b.cx ? p.x + p.w : p.x - 24, p.y + p.h / 2 - 7, 24, 14);
		}
		for (const ty of [
			b.cy - 190,
			b.cy,
			b.cy + 190
		]) {
			const tx = Math.max(26, b.minX - 58);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#64748b";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(tx + 58, ty - 34);
			ctx.lineTo(tx, ty - 22);
			ctx.lineTo(tx, ty + 22);
			ctx.lineTo(tx + 58, ty + 34);
			ctx.closePath();
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		}
		const dx = Math.min(1995, b.maxX + 40);
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#94a3b8";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(b.maxX, b.cy - 60);
		ctx.lineTo(dx + 24, b.cy - 60);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(dx + 26, b.cy - 60, 14, -Math.PI * .65, Math.PI * .65);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
	} else for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
		const ang = i / 26 * Math.PI * 2;
		const ox = b.cx + Math.cos(ang) * ((b.maxX - b.minX) * .56 + 68);
		const oy = b.cy + Math.sin(ang) * ((b.maxY - b.minY) * .56 + 58);
		if (ox < 24 || ox > 2056 || oy < 24 || oy > 1316) continue;
		if (theme === "snow") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.18)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.38)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.ellipse(ox, oy, 42, 26, ang, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		} else if (theme === "lava") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.28)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.65)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.ellipse(ox, oy, 34, 20, ang * .7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		} else if (theme === "crystal") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.24)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#5eead4";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(ox, oy - 26);
			ctx.lineTo(ox + 18, oy + 14);
			ctx.lineTo(ox - 18, oy + 14);
			ctx.closePath();
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		} else if (theme === "jungle") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.22)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.45)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(ox, oy, 28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		} else if (theme === "ocean") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.4)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(ox, oy, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		} else {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.22)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.45)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.ellipse(ox, oy, 38, 22, ang, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	}
	ctx.restore();
}
function drawRoomFloorPattern(ctx, r) {
	ctx.save();
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 16);
	ctx.clip();
	ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
	ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
	const style = r.floorStyle || "metal";
	if (style === "tile") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1;
		for (let x = r.x; x < r.x + r.w; x += 44) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(x, r.y);
			ctx.lineTo(x, r.y + r.h);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
		for (let y = r.y; y < r.y + r.h; y += 44) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(r.x, y);
			ctx.lineTo(r.x + r.w, y);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	} else if (style === "lab") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1;
		for (let x = r.x; x < r.x + r.w; x += 36) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(x, r.y);
			ctx.lineTo(x, r.y + r.h);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
		for (let y = r.y; y < r.y + r.h; y += 36) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(r.x, y);
			ctx.lineTo(r.x + r.w, y);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	} else if (style === "cargo") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.045)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 8;
		for (let x = r.x - r.h; x < r.x + r.w; x += 48) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(x, r.y);
			ctx.lineTo(x + r.h, r.y + r.h);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	} else if (style === "cyber") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(232, 121, 249, 0.11)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
		for (let x = r.x + 24; x < r.x + r.w; x += 64) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(x, r.y);
			ctx.lineTo(x, r.y + r.h);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
		for (let y = r.y + 24; y < r.y + r.h; y += 64) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(r.x, y);
			ctx.lineTo(r.x + r.w, y);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	} else if (style === "carpet") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.08)";
		ctx.fillRect(r.x + 24, r.y + 24, r.w - 48, r.h - 48);
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.16)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2;
		ctx.strokeRect(r.x + 24, r.y + 24, r.w - 48, r.h - 48);
	} else if (style === "stone") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(214, 211, 209, 0.1)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
		for (let row = 0, y = r.y; y < r.y + r.h; row++, y += 42) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(r.x, y);
			ctx.lineTo(r.x + r.w, y);
			ctx.stroke();
			const offset = row % 2 * 34;
			for (let x = r.x + offset; x < r.x + r.w; x += 68) {
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(x, y);
				ctx.lineTo(x, Math.min(r.y + r.h, y + 42));
				ctx.stroke();
			}
		}
	} else if (style === "garden") {
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.07)";
		for (let x = r.x + 36; x < r.x + r.w - 20; x += 64) for (let y = r.y + 36; y < r.y + r.h - 20; y += 56) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(x, y, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		}
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.08)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
		ctx.strokeRect(r.x + 22, r.y + 22, r.w - 44, r.h - 44);
	} else {
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
		for (let x = r.x; x < r.x + r.w; x += 72) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(x, r.y);
			ctx.lineTo(x, r.y + r.h);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
		for (let y = r.y; y < r.y + r.h; y += 56) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(r.x, y);
			ctx.lineTo(r.x + r.w, y);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	}
	ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)";
	ctx.lineWidth = 3;
	ctx.strokeRect(r.x + 12, r.y + 12, r.w - 24, r.h - 24);
	ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22)";
	for (const [rx, ry] of [
		[r.x + 18, r.y + 18],
		[r.x + r.w - 18, r.y + 18],
		[r.x + 18, r.y + r.h - 18],
		[r.x + r.w - 18, r.y + r.h - 18]
	]) {
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(rx, ry, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	}
	const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, r.y, 0, r.y + 26);
	grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0.48)");
	grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
	ctx.fillStyle = grad;
	ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, 26);
	ctx.restore();
}
function getBakedMapCanvas(mapDef, floor, staticSegs) {
	if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
	const key = `${mapDef.id}_f${floor}`;
	const cached = mapBakeCache.get(key);
	if (cached) return cached;
	const off = document.createElement("canvas");
	off.width = 2080;
	off.height = 1340;
	const ctx = off.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return null;
	const rooms = mapDef.rooms.filter((r) => (r.floor || 1) === floor);
	const corridors = mapDef.corridors.filter((c) => (c.floor || 1) === floor);
	const vents = mapDef.vents.filter((v) => (v.floor || 1) === floor);
	drawExteriorDetails(ctx, mapDef, floor);
	ctx.lineJoin = "round";
	ctx.strokeStyle = "#030610";
	ctx.lineWidth = 34;
	for (const c of corridors) ctx.strokeRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h);
	for (const r of rooms) {
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 16);
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	ctx.strokeStyle = mapDef.wallColor || "#334155";
	ctx.lineWidth = 24;
	for (const c of corridors) ctx.strokeRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h);
	for (const r of rooms) {
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 16);
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.26)";
	for (const r of rooms) for (let x = r.x + 28; x < r.x + r.w - 20; x += 68) {
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(x, r.y - 7, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.arc(x, r.y + r.h + 7, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	}
	ctx.fillStyle = mapDef.corridorFill;
	for (const c of corridors) {
		ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h);
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2;
		if (c.w > c.h) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y + c.h / 2);
			ctx.lineTo(c.x + c.w, c.y + c.h / 2);
			ctx.stroke();
			for (let x = c.x + 48; x < c.x + c.w - 20; x += 76) {
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(x, c.y + 4);
				ctx.lineTo(x, c.y + c.h - 4);
				ctx.stroke();
			}
		} else {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(c.x + c.w / 2, c.y);
			ctx.lineTo(c.x + c.w / 2, c.y + c.h);
			ctx.stroke();
			for (let y = c.y + 48; y < c.y + c.h - 20; y += 76) {
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(c.x + 4, y);
				ctx.lineTo(c.x + c.w - 4, y);
				ctx.stroke();
			}
		}
	}
	for (const r of rooms) {
		drawRoomFloorPattern(ctx, r);
		ctx.font = "900 18px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillText(r.name, r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h / 2);
	}
	ctx.strokeStyle = mapDef.accent;
	ctx.lineWidth = 4;
	ctx.lineCap = "round";
	ctx.beginPath();
	for (const s of staticSegs) {
		ctx.moveTo(s.x1, s.y1);
		ctx.lineTo(s.x2, s.y2);
	}
	ctx.stroke();
	if ((mapDef.emergency.floor || 1) === floor) {
		const em = mapDef.emergency;
		for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
			const a = i / 6 * Math.PI * 2;
			ctx.fillStyle = "#334155";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(em.x + Math.cos(a) * 54, em.y + Math.sin(a) * 54, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		}
		ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#64748b";
		ctx.lineWidth = 4;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(em.x, em.y, 42, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#ef4444";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(em.x, em.y, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4444";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(em.x, em.y, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.48)";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(em.x - 4, em.y - 4, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
	}
	for (const v of vents) {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#94a3b8";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.roundRect(v.x - 20, v.y - 14, 40, 28, 5);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#090d16";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
		for (let vy = v.y - 8; vy <= v.y + 8; vy += 5) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(v.x - 14, vy);
			ctx.lineTo(v.x + 14, vy);
			ctx.stroke();
		}
		ctx.fillStyle = "#cbd5e1";
		for (const [bx, by] of [
			[v.x - 16, v.y - 10],
			[v.x + 16, v.y - 10],
			[v.x - 16, v.y + 10],
			[v.x + 16, v.y + 10]
		]) {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(bx, by, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		}
	}
	mapBakeCache.set(key, off);
	return off;
}
function drawDecorsAndObstacles(ctx, mapDef, anyCameraActive, nowMs, floor) {
	for (const d of mapDef.decors) {
		if ((d.floor || 1) !== floor) continue;
		ctx.save();
		if (d.kind === "window") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#020617";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#64748b";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h, 6);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)";
			ctx.fillRect(d.x + 4, d.y + 4, d.w - 8, d.h - 8);
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.75)";
			ctx.fillRect(d.x + 10, d.y + 7, 2, 2);
			ctx.fillRect(d.x + d.w - 16, d.y + d.h - 10, 2.5, 2.5);
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.35)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(d.x + 8, d.y + d.h - 5);
			ctx.lineTo(d.x + 22, d.y + 5);
			ctx.stroke();
		} else if (d.kind === "med_scanner") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#34d399";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h, 12);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(52, 211, 153, ${.25 + .18 * Math.sin(nowMs * .005)})`;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2, d.w * .36, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#6ee7b7";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			const rot = nowMs * .003;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2, d.w * .25, rot, rot + Math.PI * 1.15);
			ctx.stroke();
		} else if (d.kind === "med_bed") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#334155";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h, 7);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#f1f5f9";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(d.x + 6, d.y + 6, d.w - 12, 14, 4);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(d.x + 6, d.y + 24, d.w - 12, d.h - 30, 4);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#020617";
			ctx.fillRect(d.x - 10, d.y + 6, 8, 12);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#22c55e";
			ctx.fillRect(d.x - 8, d.y + 10, 4, 2);
		} else if (d.kind === "turret") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#fb7185";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h, 9);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#064e3b";
			ctx.fillRect(d.x + 8, d.y + 8, d.w - 16, 18);
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#34d399";
			ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + 17, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.stroke();
		} else if (d.kind === "caution") {
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.rect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.clip();
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.55)";
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.45)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 7;
			for (let x = d.x - d.h; x < d.x + d.w + d.h; x += 18) {
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(x, d.y);
				ctx.lineTo(x + d.h, d.y + d.h);
				ctx.stroke();
			}
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.72)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
		} else if (d.kind === "pipes") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#334155";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, 7);
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, 7);
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y + 12, d.w, 7);
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y + 12, d.w, 7);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#94a3b8";
			for (let x = d.x + 28; x < d.x + d.w - 12; x += 64) ctx.fillRect(x - 2, d.y - 2, 5, 23);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4444";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + 3, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		} else if (d.kind === "carpet") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(190, 24, 93, 0.24)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.45)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
		} else if (d.kind === "altar") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#78350f";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#facc15";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
		} else if (d.kind === "server_wall") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#334155";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			for (let x = d.x + 12; x < d.x + d.w - 8; x += 18) {
				ctx.fillStyle = Math.sin(nowMs * .005 + x) > 0 ? "#22d3ee" : "#e879f9";
				ctx.fillRect(x, d.y + 5, 6, 5);
			}
		} else if (d.kind === "camera_prop") {
			const cx = d.x + d.w / 2;
			const cy = d.y + d.h / 2;
			ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#94a3b8";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx, cy, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = anyCameraActive && Math.floor(nowMs / 350) % 2 === 0 ? "#ef4444" : anyCameraActive ? "#991b1b" : "#334155";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx + 3, cy - 2, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		}
		ctx.restore();
	}
	for (const obs of mapDef.obstacles) {
		if ((obs.floor || 1) !== floor) continue;
		ctx.save();
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.48)";
		if (obs.kind === "table_round") {
			const cx = obs.x + obs.w / 2;
			const cy = obs.y + obs.h / 2;
			const rad = obs.w / 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx + 3, cy + 5, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx, cy, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx, cy, rad * .72, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#cbd5e1";
			ctx.fillRect(cx - 10, cy - 8, 12, 8);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx + 8, cy + 6, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		} else if (obs.kind === "table_rect") {
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 3, obs.y + 5, obs.w, obs.h);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#334155";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h, 8);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 12, obs.y + 10, Math.max(8, obs.w - 24), 8);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 12, obs.y + 24, 14, 6);
		} else if (obs.kind === "crate") {
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 4, obs.y + 6, obs.w, obs.h);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#6b4c35";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#1c1917";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h, 6);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#926c4c";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.strokeRect(obs.x + 6, obs.y + 6, obs.w - 12, obs.h - 12);
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(obs.x + 6, obs.y + 6);
			ctx.lineTo(obs.x + obs.w - 6, obs.y + obs.h - 6);
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + obs.w - 14, obs.y + 4, 8, 5);
		} else if (obs.kind === "server") {
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 4, obs.y + 6, obs.w, obs.h);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#020617";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h, 6);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			for (let y = obs.y + 10; y < obs.y + obs.h - 12; y += 16) {
				ctx.fillStyle = Math.sin(nowMs * .004 + y) > 0 ? "#22d3ee" : "#34d399";
				ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 8, y, obs.w - 16, 4);
			}
		} else if (obs.kind === "reactor") {
			const cx = obs.x + obs.w / 2;
			const cy = obs.y + obs.h / 2;
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 3, obs.y + 5, obs.w, obs.h);
			ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h, 14);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			const p = .55 + .35 * Math.sin(nowMs * .006);
			ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${p})`;
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx, cy, Math.min(obs.w, obs.h) * .38, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${p})`;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx, cy, Math.min(obs.w, obs.h) * .25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		} else if (obs.kind === "tank") {
			const cx = obs.x + obs.w / 2;
			const cy = obs.y + obs.h / 2;
			ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#2dd4bf";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx, cy, obs.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.38)";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx, cy, obs.w * .34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		} else if (obs.kind === "rock") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h, 16);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		} else if (obs.kind === "console") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.w, obs.h, 8);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#020617";
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 6, obs.y + 6, obs.w - 12, Math.max(8, obs.h - 16));
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6)";
			ctx.fillRect(obs.x + 8, obs.y + 9, Math.max(6, (obs.w - 16) * .7), 3);
		}
		ctx.restore();
	}
}
function drawGimmickNode(ctx, g, ringColor, nowMs) {
	const pulse = .7 + .3 * Math.sin(nowMs * .006);
	ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.88)";
	ctx.strokeStyle = ringColor;
	ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.arc(g.x, g.y, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
	ctx.fill();
	ctx.stroke();
	if (g.type === "stairs") {
		ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${pulse * .55})`;
		ctx.lineWidth = 2;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(g.x, g.y, 31, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	ctx.font = "18px sans-serif";
	ctx.textAlign = "center";
	ctx.fillText(g.icon || "✨", g.x, g.y + 6);
	ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
	ctx.fillStyle = "#e0f2fe";
	ctx.fillText(g.label, g.x, g.y + 40);
}
function drawGimmicksAndDoors(ctx, mapDef, doorBlockers, steamActive, nowMs, floor, matchElapsedSec) {
	for (const g of mapDef.gimmicks) {
		if ((g.floor || 1) !== floor) continue;
		ctx.save();
		if (g.type === "ice" && g.w && g.h) {
			ctx.save();
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h, 14);
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.2)";
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.72)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.clip();
			const sweep = nowMs * .08 % (g.w + g.h + 120) - 60;
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 18;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(g.x + sweep - 40, g.y - 10);
			ctx.lineTo(g.x + sweep + 40, g.y + g.h + 10);
			ctx.stroke();
			for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
				const sx = g.x + (i * 83 + 28) % Math.max(20, g.w - 36);
				const sy = g.y + (i * 59 + 24) % Math.max(20, g.h - 32);
				ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(224, 242, 254, ${.35 + .4 * Math.abs(Math.sin(nowMs * .005 + i))})`;
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.arc(sx, sy, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
				ctx.fill();
			}
			ctx.restore();
			ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#e0f2fe";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText("❄️ 凍結アイスフロア（滑走注意）", g.x + g.w / 2, g.y + 22);
		} else if (g.type === "low_gravity" && g.w && g.h) {
			const cx = g.x + g.w / 2;
			const cy = g.y + g.h / 2;
			const rad = Math.min(g.w, g.h) * .45;
			const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 8, cx, cy, rad);
			grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.26)");
			grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.06)");
			ctx.fillStyle = grad;
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(196, 181, 253, 0.68)";
			ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]);
			ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h, 14);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.setLineDash([]);
			const ringT = nowMs * .0012 % 1;
			ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(216, 180, 254, ${(1 - ringT) * .55})`;
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(cx, cy, Math.max(12, rad * ringT), 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#ede9fe";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText("🪐 低重力エリア（移動+18%）", cx, g.y + 22);
		} else if (g.type === "conveyor" && g.w && g.h) {
			ctx.save();
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(14, 116, 144, 0.28)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.fillRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h);
			ctx.strokeRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h);
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)";
			ctx.fillRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, 6);
			ctx.fillRect(g.x, g.y + g.h - 6, g.w, 6);
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.rect(g.x, g.y + 6, g.w, Math.max(4, g.h - 12));
			ctx.clip();
			const vx = g.vx || 0;
			const vy = g.vy || 0;
			const dir = Math.atan2(vy, vx || (vy === 0 ? 1 : 0));
			const spd = Math.max(40, Math.hypot(vx, vy));
			const shift = nowMs * .001 * spd * .72 % 38;
			const cx = g.x + g.w / 2;
			const cy = g.y + g.h / 2;
			const span = Math.hypot(g.w, g.h) * .65;
			ctx.save();
			ctx.translate(cx, cy);
			ctx.rotate(dir);
			for (let x = -span + shift; x <= span; x += 38) {
				ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(125, 211, 252, ${.45 + .35 * Math.sin(nowMs * .008 - x * .05)})`;
				ctx.lineWidth = 3.2;
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(x - 10, -18);
				ctx.lineTo(x + 8, 0);
				ctx.lineTo(x - 10, 18);
				ctx.stroke();
			}
			ctx.restore();
			ctx.restore();
			ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#e0f2fe";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText("⏩ リニア搬送レーン ⏩", g.x + g.w / 2, g.y + g.h / 2 + 4);
		} else if (g.type === "spore_mist" && g.w && g.h) {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(132, 204, 22, 0.18)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.45)";
			ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.roundRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h, 16);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.setLineDash([]);
			ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#d9f99d";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText("🌿 胞子ミスト（視界制限）", g.x + g.w / 2, g.y + 22);
		} else if (g.type === "steam_hazard" && g.w && g.h) {
			if (steamActive) {
				ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.25)";
				ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.7)";
				ctx.lineWidth = 2;
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.roundRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h, 14);
				ctx.fill();
				ctx.stroke();
				ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
				ctx.fillStyle = "#fed7aa";
				ctx.textAlign = "center";
				ctx.fillText("💨 マグマ蒸気噴出中（視界制限）", g.x + g.w / 2, g.y + 22);
			} else {
				ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.25)";
				ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
				ctx.strokeRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h);
				ctx.setLineDash([]);
			}
		} else if (g.type === "lockdown_door") {
			drawGimmickNode(ctx, g, "#f43f5e", nowMs);
			if (g.doorRect && !doorBlockers.some((d) => d.x === g.doorRect?.x && d.y === g.doorRect?.y)) {
				ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35)";
				ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
				ctx.lineWidth = 2;
				ctx.strokeRect(g.doorRect.x, g.doorRect.y, g.doorRect.w, g.doorRect.h);
				ctx.setLineDash([]);
			}
		} else if ((g.type === "auto_door" || g.type === "shifting_wall") && g.doorRect) {
			const st = getDynamicDoorState(g, matchElapsedSec);
			const r = g.doorRect;
			const isAuto = g.type === "auto_door";
			if (st.closed) {
				ctx.font = "bold 10px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
				ctx.fillStyle = isAuto ? "#bae6fd" : "#e9d5ff";
				ctx.textAlign = "center";
				ctx.fillText(`${isAuto ? "🚧" : "🧱"} 解除 ${Math.ceil(st.timeRemaining)}s`, r.x + r.w / 2, r.y - 6);
			} else {
				const warnFlash = st.warning ? .55 + .45 * Math.sin(nowMs * .018) : .32;
				ctx.fillStyle = st.warning ? `rgba(250, 204, 21, ${.22 * warnFlash})` : isAuto ? "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1)" : "rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1)";
				ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
				ctx.strokeStyle = st.warning ? `rgba(250, 204, 21, ${.7 + .3 * warnFlash})` : isAuto ? "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)" : "rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.45)";
				ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
				ctx.lineWidth = st.warning ? 2.5 : 1.5;
				ctx.strokeRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
				ctx.setLineDash([]);
				ctx.font = "bold 10px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
				ctx.fillStyle = st.warning ? "#fde047" : "#94a3b8";
				ctx.textAlign = "center";
				ctx.fillText(`${isAuto ? "🚪" : "🧱"} ${st.warning ? "⚠間もなく閉鎖" : "開放"} ${Math.ceil(st.timeRemaining)}s`, r.x + r.w / 2, r.y - 6);
			}
		} else if (g.type === "boost_vent") drawGimmickNode(ctx, g, "#fb923c", nowMs);
		else if (g.type === "stairs") drawGimmickNode(ctx, g, "#22d3ee", nowMs);
		else drawGimmickNode(ctx, g, "#38bdf8", nowMs);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	for (const d of doorBlockers) {
		if ((d.floor || 1) !== floor) continue;
		ctx.save();
		if (d.doorKind === "auto_door") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(14, 116, 144, 0.9)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#e0f2fe";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText("🚧 自動隔壁", d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2 + 4);
		} else if (d.doorKind === "shifting_wall") {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(88, 28, 135, 0.92)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#c084fc";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#f3e8ff";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText("🧱 可変障壁", d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2 + 4);
		} else {
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.84)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#fda4af";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.strokeRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText("🔒 封鎖中", d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2 + 4);
		}
		ctx.restore();
	}
}
function drawSpaceBackdrop(ctx, vw, vh, camX, camY, mapDef, nowMs, meteorActive) {
	const theme = mapDef.exteriorTheme || "space";
	if (theme === "space" || theme === "moon" || theme === "cyber") {
		const px = (vw * .78 - camX * .04) % (vw + 200);
		const py = (vh * .24 - camY * .04) % (vh + 150);
		const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(px - 14, py - 14, 6, px, py, 44);
		grad.addColorStop(0, theme === "cyber" ? "#a855f7" : "#38bdf8");
		grad.addColorStop(1, "#090d16");
		ctx.fillStyle = grad;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(px, py, 44, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.32)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 4;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.ellipse(px, py, 76, 16, -.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	for (let i = 0; i < 68; i++) {
		const spd = i % 3 === 0 ? .18 : i % 3 === 1 ? .1 : .05;
		const sx = ((i * 197 - camX * spd) % vw + vw) % vw;
		const sy = ((i * 131 - camY * spd + (theme === "snow" ? nowMs * .025 : 0)) % vh + vh) % vh;
		const size = i % 5 === 0 ? 3 : i % 2 === 0 ? 2 : 1.4;
		const alpha = .35 + .55 * Math.abs(Math.sin(nowMs * .002 + i));
		ctx.fillStyle = theme === "lava" ? `rgba(251, 146, 60, ${alpha})` : theme === "jungle" ? `rgba(163, 230, 53, ${alpha})` : `rgba(226, 232, 240, ${alpha})`;
		ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, size, size);
	}
	if (meteorActive) {
		ctx.save();
		for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
			const mx = ((i * 251 + nowMs * .55) % (vw + 260) + (vw + 260)) % (vw + 260) - 130;
			const my = ((i * 163 + nowMs * .35) % (vh + 220) + (vh + 220)) % (vh + 220) - 110;
			ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.72)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(mx - 28, my - 18);
			ctx.lineTo(mx, my);
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(mx, my, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		}
		ctx.restore();
	}
}
function renderGameCanvas(params) {
	const { canvas, mapDef, me, players, bodies, abilityTraces, killBursts, ghostPulses, visualEffects = [], myTasks, completedTasks, hasTasks, sabotage, visionRadius, doorBlockers, anyCameraActive, cameraWatchTimer, cameraWatchTarget, cameraBatteryPct, sonarPingTimer, psychicTimer, oiledPlayers, crystalBeaconTimer, sandstormActive, steamActive, meteorActive, bellRingTimer, bellPos, hauntedTimer, boostTimer, executionerTargetId, matchElapsedSec = 0, showNavArrows = true, nowMs } = params;
	const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
	if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) return;
	const vw = Math.floor(rect.width);
	const vh = Math.floor(rect.height);
	if (canvas.width !== vw || canvas.height !== vh) {
		canvas.width = vw;
		canvas.height = vh;
	}
	const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return;
	const isCam = cameraWatchTimer > 0 && !!cameraWatchTarget;
	const camX = isCam && cameraWatchTarget ? cameraWatchTarget.x : me.x;
	const camY = isCam && cameraWatchTarget ? cameraWatchTarget.y : me.y;
	const activeFloor = isCam && cameraWatchTarget?.floor ? cameraWatchTarget.floor : me.floor || 1;
	ctx.fillStyle = mapDef.bg;
	ctx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
	drawSpaceBackdrop(ctx, vw, vh, camX, camY, mapDef, nowMs, meteorActive);
	const staticSegs = getStaticSightBlockingSegments(mapDef, activeFloor);
	const allSegs = doorBlockers.length === 0 ? staticSegs : getSightBlockingSegments(mapDef, activeFloor, doorBlockers);
	const baked = getBakedMapCanvas(mapDef, activeFloor, staticSegs);
	ctx.save();
	ctx.translate(vw / 2 - camX, vh / 2 - camY);
	if (baked) {
		const sx = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camX - vw / 2));
		const sy = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camY - vh / 2));
		const sw = Math.min(baked.width - sx, Math.ceil(camX + vw / 2) - sx);
		const sh = Math.min(baked.height - sy, Math.ceil(camY + vh / 2) - sy);
		if (sw > 0 && sh > 0) ctx.drawImage(baked, sx, sy, sw, sh, sx, sy, sw, sh);
	}
	const extTheme = mapDef.exteriorTheme || "space";
	if (extTheme === "space" || extTheme === "moon" || extTheme === "cyber" || extTheme === "clouds") {
		const b = getFloorBounds(mapDef, activeFloor);
		const tx = Math.max(26, b.minX - 58);
		const flameLen = 34 + Math.sin(nowMs * .025) * 14;
		for (const ty of [
			b.cy - 190,
			b.cy,
			b.cy + 190
		]) {
			const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(tx, ty, tx - flameLen, ty);
			grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.85)");
			grad.addColorStop(.5, "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)");
			grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0)");
			ctx.fillStyle = grad;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(tx, ty - 16);
			ctx.lineTo(tx - flameLen, ty);
			ctx.lineTo(tx, ty + 16);
			ctx.closePath();
			ctx.fill();
		}
	}
	drawGimmicksAndDoors(ctx, mapDef, doorBlockers, steamActive, nowMs, activeFloor, matchElapsedSec);
	drawDecorsAndObstacles(ctx, mapDef, anyCameraActive, nowMs, activeFloor);
	if (hasTasks) for (const taskId of myTasks) {
		if (completedTasks[taskId]) continue;
		const taskDef = TASKS.find((t) => t.id === taskId);
		for (const spot of mapDef.taskSpots) {
			if (spot.taskId !== taskId || (spot.floor || 1) !== activeFloor) continue;
			const dist = Math.hypot(spot.x - me.x, spot.y - me.y);
			drawTaskFixture(ctx, spot.x, spot.y, taskDef?.type, taskDef?.name || "タスク", dist <= 84, nowMs);
		}
	}
	if (sabotage && sabotage.type !== "doors") {
		const fix = mapDef.sabotageFix[sabotage.type];
		if (fix && (fix.floor || 1) === activeFloor) {
			const pulseR = 28 + Math.sin(nowMs * .01) * 5;
			ctx.fillStyle = sabotage.type === "gas" ? "rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35)" : "rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35)";
			ctx.strokeStyle = sabotage.type === "gas" ? "#c084fc" : "#f43f5e";
			ctx.lineWidth = 4;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(fix.x, fix.y, pulseR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#fecdd3";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(`🚨 ${fix.label}`, fix.x, fix.y - 36);
		}
	}
	if (me.role === "psychic" && psychicTimer > 0) for (const tr of abilityTraces) {
		if ((tr.floor || 1) !== activeFloor) continue;
		ctx.save();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.85)";
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.22)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 3;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(tr.x, tr.y, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = "#e9d5ff";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillText(tr.label || "🔮 能力・殺害残滓", tr.x, tr.y - 40);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	const meIsImp = isImpostorRole(me.role);
	const sightDist = isCam ? 320 : visionRadius + 24;
	const isVisible = (tx, ty, f) => {
		if (f !== activeFloor) return false;
		if ((!me.alive || me.isSpectator) && !isCam) return true;
		return hasLineOfSight(camX, camY, tx, ty, allSegs, sightDist);
	};
	for (const b of bodies) {
		if (!isVisible(b.x, b.y, b.floor || 1)) continue;
		const alpha = typeof b.dissolveTimer === "number" && b.dissolveTimer > 0 ? Math.max(.2, Math.min(1, b.dissolveTimer / 12)) : 1;
		drawPlayer(ctx, b.x, b.y, b.color, "none", 1, false, false, alpha, false, nowMs);
	}
	const sortedPlayers = Object.values(players).filter((p) => !p.isSpectator && (p.floor || 1) === activeFloor).sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
	for (const p of sortedPlayers) {
		if (p.inVent || !p.alive && me.alive && !me.isSpectator || p.invisible && p.id !== me.id && !(meIsImp && isImpostorRole(p.role)) || p.id !== me.id && !isVisible(p.x, p.y, p.floor || 1)) continue;
		const alpha = p.invisible ? .35 : 1;
		const disg = p.disguisedAs || null;
		const renderColor = disg ? disg.color : p.color;
		const renderHat = disg ? disg.hat || "none" : p.hat || "none";
		const renderSkin = disg?.skin || p.skin || "standard";
		const renderName = disg ? disg.name : p.name;
		const petId = p.pet || "none";
		if (p.alive && petId !== "none" && !p.invisible) {
			const targetPx = p.x - (p.facing || 1) * 30;
			const targetPy = p.y + 14;
			const prev = petSmoothCache.get(p.id) || {
				x: targetPx,
				y: targetPy
			};
			const dist = Math.hypot(targetPx - prev.x, targetPy - prev.y);
			const sx = dist > 140 ? targetPx : prev.x + (targetPx - prev.x) * .16;
			const sy = dist > 140 ? targetPy : prev.y + (targetPy - prev.y) * .16;
			petSmoothCache.set(p.id, {
				x: sx,
				y: sy
			});
			drawPet(ctx, sx, sy, petId, renderColor, p.facing || 1, dist > 3.5, nowMs);
		}
		drawPlayer(ctx, p.x, p.y, renderColor, renderHat, p.facing || 1, p.alive, !p.alive, alpha, !!p.shielded, nowMs, void 0, renderSkin);
		const allyImp = meIsImp && isImpostorRole(p.role);
		const execTarget = me.role === "executioner" && executionerTargetId === p.id;
		ctx.font = "bold 13px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillStyle = allyImp ? "#fb7185" : execTarget ? "#facc15" : "#ffffff";
		ctx.fillText(execTarget ? `🎯 ${renderName}` : renderName, p.x, p.y - 38);
		if (me.role === "arsonist" && p.id !== me.id && p.alive && (oiledPlayers[p.id] || p.doused)) {
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#fb923c";
			ctx.fillText("🛢️ 塗布済", p.x, p.y - 53);
		}
	}
	for (const gp of ghostPulses) {
		if ((gp.floor || 1) !== activeFloor) continue;
		const t = (nowMs - gp.startedAt) / 1400;
		if (t < 0 || t > 1) continue;
		ctx.save();
		ctx.strokeStyle = gp.kind === "assist" ? `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${1 - t})` : `rgba(192, 132, 252, ${1 - t})`;
		ctx.lineWidth = 3;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(gp.x, gp.y, 18 + t * 72, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.restore();
	}
	for (const vfx of visualEffects) {
		if (nowMs > vfx.expiresAt || !isVisible(vfx.x, vfx.y, vfx.floor || 1)) continue;
		const p = Math.max(0, 1 - (vfx.expiresAt - nowMs) / 4200);
		ctx.save();
		if (vfx.kind === "med_scan") {
			const scanY = vfx.y - 24 + nowMs * .09 % 48;
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#34d399";
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.22)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(vfx.x, vfx.y, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#6ee7b7";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(vfx.x - 28, scanY);
			ctx.lineTo(vfx.x + 28, scanY);
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#a7f3d0";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(`🏥 医療スキャン中 (${vfx.playerName})`, vfx.x, vfx.y - 44);
		} else if (vfx.kind === "turret_laser") {
			const ang = Math.sin(nowMs * .015) * .55 - Math.PI / 2;
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#f43f5e";
			ctx.lineWidth = 5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(vfx.x, vfx.y);
			ctx.lineTo(vfx.x + Math.cos(ang) * 140, vfx.y + Math.sin(ang) * 140);
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#fef08a";
			ctx.lineWidth = 2;
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#fecdd3";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(`🔫 タレット迎撃中 (${vfx.playerName})`, vfx.x, vfx.y - 36);
		} else if (vfx.kind === "trash_eject") {
			for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
				const dx = (i - 2.5) * 14 + p * 24;
				const dy = 20 + (nowMs * .14 + i * 23) % 70;
				ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? "#94a3b8" : "#fbbf24";
				ctx.fillRect(vfx.x + dx - 4, vfx.y + dy - 4, 8, 8);
			}
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#fde68a";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(`🗑️ ダスト排出中 (${vfx.playerName})`, vfx.x, vfx.y - 36);
		} else if (vfx.kind === "shield_dome") {
			const rad = 36 + Math.sin(nowMs * .014) * 8;
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#38bdf8";
			ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22)";
			ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(vfx.x, vfx.y, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#bae6fd";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(`🛡️ シールド展開中 (${vfx.playerName})`, vfx.x, vfx.y - 48);
		} else if (vfx.kind === "reactor_beam") {
			ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(34, 211, 238, ${.5 + .45 * Math.sin(nowMs * .02)})`;
			ctx.lineWidth = 4;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(vfx.x, vfx.y, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.stroke();
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#a5f3fc";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(`⚛️ 炉心同調中 (${vfx.playerName})`, vfx.x, vfx.y - 48);
		}
		ctx.restore();
	}
	for (const kb of killBursts) if (isVisible(kb.x, kb.y, kb.floor || 1)) drawKillEffectBurst(ctx, kb, nowMs);
	ctx.restore();
	if (me.alive && !me.isSpectator || isCam) {
		const rVis = isCam ? 290 : visionRadius;
		const poly = computeVisibilityPolygon(camX, camY, rVis, allSegs);
		if (poly.length >= 3) {
			const darkness = sabotage?.type === "lights" && !meIsImp && me.role !== "jackal" ? .97 : sabotage?.type === "gas" && !meIsImp && me.role !== "jackal" ? .91 : .83;
			const offX = vw / 2 - camX;
			const offY = vh / 2 - camY;
			ctx.save();
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.rect(0, 0, vw, vh);
			ctx.moveTo(poly[0].x + offX, poly[0].y + offY);
			for (let i = poly.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) ctx.lineTo(poly[i].x + offX, poly[i].y + offY);
			ctx.closePath();
			ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(3, 6, 15, ${darkness})`;
			ctx.fill("evenodd");
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.moveTo(poly[0].x + offX, poly[0].y + offY);
			for (let i = 1; i < poly.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(poly[i].x + offX, poly[i].y + offY);
			ctx.closePath();
			ctx.clip();
			const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(vw / 2, vh / 2, rVis * .55, vw / 2, vh / 2, rVis);
			grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(3, 6, 15, 0)");
			grad.addColorStop(.78, "rgba(3, 6, 15, 0.14)");
			grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(3, 6, 15, ${darkness})`);
			ctx.fillStyle = grad;
			ctx.fillRect(vw / 2 - rVis, vh / 2 - rVis, rVis * 2, rVis * 2);
			ctx.restore();
		}
	}
	if (sabotage?.type === "gas" && me.alive && !me.isSpectator) {
		ctx.save();
		const gGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(vw / 2, vh / 2, vw * .15, vw / 2, vh / 2, Math.max(vw, vh) * .7);
		gGrad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.06)");
		gGrad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(88, 28, 135, 0.42)");
		ctx.fillStyle = gGrad;
		ctx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	if (sandstormActive && me.alive) {
		ctx.save();
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.08)";
		ctx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
		ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = "#fde68a";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillText("🏜️ 砂嵐発生中（屋外通路の視界低下）", vw / 2, vh - 18);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	if (boostTimer > 0 && me.alive) {
		ctx.save();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.48)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 6;
		ctx.strokeRect(3, 3, vw - 6, vh - 6);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	if (crystalBeaconTimer > 0) {
		ctx.save();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 4;
		ctx.strokeRect(6, 6, vw - 12, vh - 12);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	if (sonarPingTimer > 0) {
		ctx.save();
		for (const p of Object.values(players)) {
			if (!p.alive || p.id === me.id || p.inVent || (p.floor || 1) !== activeFloor) continue;
			const dx = p.x - me.x;
			const dy = p.y - me.y;
			const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
			if (d < 560 && d > 30) {
				const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
				const ix = vw / 2 + Math.cos(ang) * 115;
				const iy = vh / 2 + Math.sin(ang) * 115;
				ctx.fillStyle = "#2dd4bf";
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.arc(ix, iy, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
				ctx.fill();
				ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
				ctx.fillStyle = "#ccfbf1";
				ctx.textAlign = "center";
				ctx.fillText("📡 反応", ix, iy - 13);
			}
		}
		ctx.restore();
	}
	if (bellRingTimer > 0 && bellPos) {
		const dx = bellPos.x - me.x;
		const dy = bellPos.y - me.y;
		if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 45) {
			const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
			const ix = vw / 2 + Math.cos(ang) * 125;
			const iy = vh / 2 + Math.sin(ang) * 125;
			ctx.save();
			ctx.fillStyle = "#fbbf24";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(ix, iy, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.font = "bold 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
			ctx.fillStyle = "#fef3c7";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText("🔔 警鐘", ix, iy - 14);
			ctx.restore();
		}
	}
	if (isCam && cameraWatchTarget) {
		ctx.save();
		ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.85)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 6;
		ctx.strokeRect(4, 4, vw - 8, vh - 8);
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92)";
		ctx.fillRect(vw / 2 - 195, 12, 390, 32);
		ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		const lbl = cameraWatchTarget.label ? `【${cameraWatchTarget.label}】` : "";
		ctx.fillText(`📹 監視カメラ ${lbl} 残り ${Math.ceil(cameraWatchTimer)}s ｜ バッテリー ${Math.round(cameraBatteryPct)}%`, vw / 2, 32);
		ctx.restore();
	}
	if (sabotage?.type === "reactor" && me.alive) {
		const p = (Math.sin(nowMs * .01) + 1) * .5;
		if (p > .15) {
			ctx.save();
			ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(244, 63, 94, ${.18 + p * .34})`;
			ctx.lineWidth = 14;
			ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
			ctx.restore();
		}
	}
	if (showNavArrows && !me.isSpectator && !isCam) {
		const myFloor = me.floor || 1;
		const navTargets = [];
		if (sabotage && sabotage.type !== "doors" && me.alive) {
			const fix = mapDef.sabotageFix[sabotage.type];
			if (fix) {
				const fixFloor = fix.floor || 1;
				if (fixFloor === myFloor) navTargets.push({
					tx: fix.x,
					ty: fix.y,
					roomLabel: fix.label || "緊急修理",
					icon: "🚨",
					isSabotage: true
				});
				else {
					const stairs = mapDef.gimmicks.filter((g) => g.type === "stairs" && (g.floor || 1) === myFloor).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - me.x, a.y - me.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - me.x, b.y - me.y))[0];
					if (stairs) navTargets.push({
						tx: stairs.x,
						ty: stairs.y,
						roomLabel: `${fixFloor}F 緊急修理`,
						icon: "🚨",
						isSabotage: true,
						isFloorHop: true
					});
				}
			}
		}
		if (hasTasks) {
			const stairsOnFloor = mapDef.gimmicks.filter((g) => g.type === "stairs" && (g.floor || 1) === myFloor);
			for (const taskId of myTasks) {
				if (completedTasks[taskId]) continue;
				const spot = mapDef.taskSpots.find((s) => s.taskId === taskId);
				if (!spot) continue;
				const spotFloor = spot.floor || 1;
				const rName = getRoomName(spot.x, spot.y, mapDef, spotFloor);
				if (spotFloor === myFloor) navTargets.push({
					tx: spot.x,
					ty: spot.y,
					roomLabel: rName,
					icon: "🔧"
				});
				else if (stairsOnFloor.length > 0) {
					const nearestStairs = [...stairsOnFloor].sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - me.x, a.y - me.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - me.x, b.y - me.y))[0];
					navTargets.push({
						tx: nearestStairs.x,
						ty: nearestStairs.y,
						roomLabel: `${spotFloor}F ${rName}`,
						icon: "🪜",
						isFloorHop: true
					});
				}
			}
		}
		if (navTargets.length > 0) {
			navTargets.sort((a, b) => {
				if (a.isSabotage && !b.isSabotage) return -1;
				if (!a.isSabotage && b.isSabotage) return 1;
				return Math.hypot(a.tx - me.x, a.ty - me.y) - Math.hypot(b.tx - me.x, b.ty - me.y);
			});
			const orbitR = Math.max(90, Math.min(156, Math.min(vw, vh) * .25));
			ctx.save();
			for (const tgt of navTargets.slice(0, 3)) {
				const dx = tgt.tx - me.x;
				const dy = tgt.ty - me.y;
				if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 88) continue;
				const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
				const ax = vw / 2 + Math.cos(ang) * orbitR;
				const ay = vh / 2 + Math.sin(ang) * orbitR;
				ctx.save();
				ctx.translate(ax, ay);
				ctx.rotate(ang);
				ctx.fillStyle = tgt.isSabotage ? "#f43f5e" : tgt.isFloorHop ? "#38bdf8" : "#facc15";
				ctx.strokeStyle = "#090d16";
				ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
				ctx.lineTo(-7, -8.5);
				ctx.lineTo(-3, 0);
				ctx.lineTo(-7, 8.5);
				ctx.closePath();
				ctx.fill();
				ctx.stroke();
				ctx.restore();
				const label = `${tgt.icon} ${tgt.roomLabel}`;
				ctx.font = "bold 10px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
				const tw = ctx.measureText(label).width;
				const bx = vw / 2 + Math.cos(ang) * (orbitR + 26);
				const by = vh / 2 + Math.sin(ang) * (orbitR + 26);
				const pw = tw + 12;
				const ph = 18;
				ctx.fillStyle = tgt.isSabotage ? "rgba(127, 29, 29, 0.88)" : "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.86)";
				ctx.strokeStyle = tgt.isSabotage ? "#fb7185" : tgt.isFloorHop ? "#38bdf8" : "rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.75)";
				ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
				ctx.beginPath();
				ctx.roundRect(bx - pw / 2, by - ph / 2, pw, ph, 6);
				ctx.fill();
				ctx.stroke();
				ctx.fillStyle = "#f8fafc";
				ctx.textAlign = "center";
				ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
				ctx.fillText(label, bx, by + .5);
			}
			ctx.restore();
		}
	}
	if (hauntedTimer > 0 && me.alive) {
		ctx.save();
		const fade = Math.min(1, hauntedTimer * .9);
		const hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(vw / 2, vh / 2, vw * .18, vw / 2, vh / 2, Math.max(vw, vh) * .65);
		hg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(139, 92, 246, 0)");
		hg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(109, 40, 217, ${.42 * fade})`);
		ctx.fillStyle = hg;
		ctx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
		ctx.font = "bold 12px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = "#ddd6fe";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillText("👻 幽霊のイタズラ：視界が少し乱れています！", vw / 2, 28);
		ctx.restore();
	}
}
function renderMinimap(params) {
	const { canvas, mapDef, me, players, myTasks, completedTasks, hasTasks, sabotage, radarTimer, trackedTargetId, adminTimer, displayFloor } = params;
	const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
	const w = Math.max(300, Math.floor(rect.width));
	const h = Math.max(220, Math.floor(rect.height));
	if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
		canvas.width = w;
		canvas.height = h;
	}
	const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return;
	ctx.fillStyle = mapDef.bg;
	ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
	ctx.save();
	const scale = Math.min(w / 2050, h / 1320);
	ctx.translate((w - 2e3 * scale) / 2, (h - 1260 * scale) / 2);
	ctx.scale(scale, scale);
	ctx.fillStyle = mapDef.corridorFill;
	for (const c of mapDef.corridors) if ((c.floor || 1) === displayFloor) ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h);
	for (const r of mapDef.rooms) {
		if ((r.floor || 1) !== displayFloor) continue;
		ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
		ctx.strokeStyle = mapDef.accent;
		ctx.lineWidth = 5;
		ctx.fillRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
		ctx.strokeRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
		ctx.font = "bold 34px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = "#e2e8f0";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillText(r.name, r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h / 2);
		if (adminTimer > 0) {
			const cnt = Object.values(players).filter((p) => p.alive && !p.isSpectator && !p.inVent && (p.floor || 1) === displayFloor && p.x >= r.x && p.x <= r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y && p.y <= r.y + r.h).length;
			if (cnt > 0) {
				ctx.fillStyle = "#22c55e";
				ctx.font = "900 38px \"Orbitron\", sans-serif";
				ctx.fillText(`👤×${cnt}`, r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.h / 2 + 54);
			}
		}
	}
	for (const g of mapDef.gimmicks) if (g.type === "stairs" && (g.floor || 1) === displayFloor) {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#22d3ee";
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(g.x, g.y, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.font = "bold 26px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = "#cffafe";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillText("🪜", g.x, g.y + 9);
	}
	if (hasTasks) for (const taskId of myTasks) {
		if (completedTasks[taskId]) continue;
		for (const s of mapDef.taskSpots) if (s.taskId === taskId && (s.floor || 1) === displayFloor) {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		}
	}
	if (sabotage && sabotage.type !== "doors") {
		const fix = mapDef.sabotageFix[sabotage.type];
		if (fix && (fix.floor || 1) === displayFloor) {
			ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4444";
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(fix.x, fix.y, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
		}
	}
	if (me.role === "radar" && radarTimer > 0) {
		for (const p of Object.values(players)) if (p.alive && !p.isSpectator && p.id !== me.id && (p.floor || 1) === displayFloor) {
			ctx.fillStyle = (PLAYER_COLORS.find((c) => c.id === p.color) || PLAYER_COLORS[0]).hex;
			ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
			ctx.lineWidth = 4;
			ctx.beginPath();
			ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
			ctx.fill();
			ctx.stroke();
		}
	}
	const tracked = me.role === "tracker" && trackedTargetId ? players[trackedTargetId] : null;
	if (tracked && tracked.alive && (tracked.floor || 1) === displayFloor) {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#f43f5e";
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
		ctx.lineWidth = 5;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(tracked.x, tracked.y, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.font = "bold 28px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = "#fecdd3";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillText(`📍 ${tracked.name}`, tracked.x, tracked.y - 36);
	}
	if ((me.floor || 1) === displayFloor && !me.isSpectator) {
		ctx.fillStyle = "#22c55e";
		ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
		ctx.lineWidth = 5;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(me.x, me.y, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	ctx.restore();
}
function renderGroupLineup(params) {
	const { canvas, members, glowColor } = params;
	const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return;
	const w = canvas.width || 560;
	const h = canvas.height || 136;
	ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
	const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h * .58, 18, w / 2, h * .58, w * .52);
	g.addColorStop(0, `${glowColor}55`);
	g.addColorStop(.65, `${glowColor}1a`);
	g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(3, 6, 15, 0)");
	ctx.fillStyle = g;
	ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
	ctx.fillStyle = `${glowColor}30`;
	ctx.fillRect(0, h * .62, w, 2);
	const count = Math.min(members.length, 7);
	if (count === 0) return;
	const step = Math.min(72, (w - 60) / Math.max(1, count));
	const startX = w / 2 - (count - 1) * step / 2;
	for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
		const m = members[i];
		const cx = startX + i * step;
		const sc = m.isHighlight ? 1.48 : 1.12;
		const cy = m.isHighlight ? h * .68 : h * .64;
		if (m.pet && m.pet !== "none") {
			ctx.save();
			ctx.translate(cx - 20 * sc, cy + 10 * sc);
			ctx.scale(sc * .9, sc * .9);
			drawPet(ctx, 0, 0, m.pet, m.color, cx <= w / 2 ? 1 : -1, false, 0);
			ctx.restore();
		}
		ctx.save();
		ctx.translate(cx, cy);
		ctx.scale(sc, sc);
		drawPlayer(ctx, 0, 0, m.color, m.hat || "none", cx <= w / 2 ? 1 : -1, true, false, 1, false, 0, void 0, m.skin || "standard");
		ctx.restore();
		ctx.font = m.isHighlight ? "900 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif" : "bold 10px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.fillStyle = m.isHighlight ? "#ffffff" : "#cbd5e1";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillText(m.name, cx, h - 8);
	}
}
var LOBBY_CUSTOMIZE_TERMINAL = {
	x: 604,
	y: 88
};
/**
* 歩き回れるロビー待機室デッキ＆カスタマイズ端末を描画する
*/
function drawLobbyDeck(params) {
	const { canvas, players, nearTerminal, nowMs } = params;
	const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
	if (!ctx) return;
	const w = canvas.width;
	const h = canvas.height;
	ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
	ctx.fillStyle = "#030816";
	ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
	for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
		const sx = (i * 97 + Math.floor(nowMs * .015)) % w;
		const sy = i * 53 % 44;
		ctx.fillStyle = i % 4 === 0 ? "#38bdf8" : "#e2e8f0";
		ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 2, 2);
	}
	ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
	ctx.strokeStyle = "#334155";
	ctx.lineWidth = 4;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.roundRect(14, 38, w - 28, h - 50, 18);
	ctx.fill();
	ctx.stroke();
	ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08)";
	ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
	for (let x = 44; x < w - 24; x += 56) {
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(x, 42);
		ctx.lineTo(x, h - 16);
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	for (let y = 76; y < h - 20; y += 52) {
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(20, y);
		ctx.lineTo(w - 20, y);
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.07)";
	ctx.font = "900 13px \"Orbitron\", sans-serif";
	ctx.textAlign = "left";
	ctx.fillText("STARSHIP DROPSHIP DECK // WASD・矢印キーで移動可", 30, 62);
	const tx = LOBBY_CUSTOMIZE_TERMINAL.x;
	const ty = LOBBY_CUSTOMIZE_TERMINAL.y;
	const pulse = .65 + .35 * Math.sin(nowMs * .006);
	ctx.save();
	if (nearTerminal) {
		ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(34, 211, 238, ${.5 + .4 * pulse})`;
		ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.14)";
		ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.arc(tx, ty + 14, 58, 0, Math.PI * 2);
		ctx.fill();
		ctx.stroke();
	}
	ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
	ctx.strokeStyle = nearTerminal ? "#38bdf8" : "#64748b";
	ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.roundRect(tx - 30, ty - 28, 60, 48, 10);
	ctx.fill();
	ctx.stroke();
	ctx.fillStyle = "#020617";
	ctx.fillRect(tx - 23, ty - 21, 46, 26);
	ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${.4 + .35 * pulse})`;
	ctx.fillRect(tx - 19, ty - 17, 38, 18);
	ctx.font = "bold 14px sans-serif";
	ctx.textAlign = "center";
	ctx.fillText("🎨", tx, ty - 3);
	ctx.font = "900 10px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
	ctx.fillStyle = nearTerminal ? "#7dd3fc" : "#cbd5e1";
	ctx.fillText(nearTerminal ? "カスタマイズ [E / クリック]" : "カスタマイズ端末", tx, ty + 35);
	ctx.restore();
	const sorted = [...players].sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
	for (const p of sorted) {
		const bobY = p.y + Math.sin(nowMs * .004 + p.x * .02) * 1.4;
		ctx.save();
		drawPlayer(ctx, p.x, bobY, p.color, p.hat || "none", p.facing, true, false, 1, false, nowMs, p.pet || "none", p.skin || "standard", typeof p.petX === "number" && typeof p.petY === "number" ? {
			x: p.petX,
			y: p.petY
		} : void 0);
		ctx.font = p.isMe ? "900 11px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif" : "bold 10px \"Noto Sans JP\", sans-serif";
		ctx.textAlign = "center";
		ctx.fillStyle = p.isMe ? "#38bdf8" : "#e2e8f0";
		ctx.fillText(p.isMe ? `${p.name} ★` : p.name, p.x, bobY - 36);
		ctx.restore();
	}
}

											className: "text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-200 truncate w-full",
											children: h.name
										}),
										!unlocked && /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("span", {
											className: "text-[9px] text-amber-300",
											children: ["🔒 ", h.unlockReq]
										})
									]
								}, h.id);
							})
						}),
						tab === "pet" && /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("div", {
							className: "grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2",
							children: PETS.map((p) => {
								const unlocked = isCosmeticUnlocked("pet", p.id, progression);
								const selected = myPet === p.id;
								return /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("button", {
									type: "button",
									disabled: !unlocked,
									onClick: () => unlocked && onChangePet(p.id),
									className: `sf-btn rounded-xl p-2 border flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-center ${selected ? "bg-emerald-950/80 border-emerald-400 ring-1 ring-emerald-400" : unlocked ? "bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-500" : "bg-slate-950/75 border-slate-800 opacity-45 cursor-not-allowed"}`,
									children: [
										petPreviews[p.id] && /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("img", {
											src: petPreviews[p.id],
											alt: p.name,
											className: "w-11 h-11 object-contain"
										}),
										/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
											className: "text-[11px] font-black text-white truncate w-full",
											children: p.name
										}),
										/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
											className: "text-[9px] text-slate-400 line-clamp-1",
											children: unlocked ? p.desc : `🔒 ${p.unlockReq}`
										})
									]
								}, p.id);
							})
						}),
						tab === "kill" && /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("div", {
							className: "grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5",
							children: KILL_EFFECTS.map((k) => {
								const unlocked = isCosmeticUnlocked("killEffect", k.id, progression);
								const selected = myKillEffect === k.id;
								return /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("button", {
									type: "button",
									disabled: !unlocked,
									onClick: () => unlocked && onChangeKillEffect(k.id),
									className: `sf-btn rounded-2xl p-3 border text-left space-y-1 ${selected ? "bg-rose-950/80 border-rose-400 ring-1 ring-rose-400" : unlocked ? "bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-500" : "bg-slate-950/75 border-slate-800 opacity-45 cursor-not-allowed"}`,
									children: [/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
										className: "flex items-center gap-2",
										children: [/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
											className: "w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full shrink-0",
											style: { background: k.accent }
										}), /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("span", {
											className: "font-black text-xs text-white truncate",
											children: k.name
										})]
									}), /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("div", {
										className: "text-[10px] text-slate-400",
										children: unlocked ? "使用可能" : `🔒 ${k.unlockReq}`
									})]
								}, k.id);
							})
						})
					]
				})
			]
		})
	});
};

// src/components/LobbyScreen.tsx
var CopyRoomCodeButton = ({ code }) => {
	const [copied, setCopied] = (0, import_react.useState)(false);
	const doCopy = () => {
		const done = () => {
			setCopied(true);
			setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
		};
		try {
			if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
				navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(code)).then(done, () => {
					fallbackCopy();
				});
			} else fallbackCopy();
		} catch { fallbackCopy(); }
		function fallbackCopy() {
			const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
			ta.value = String(code);
			ta.style.position = "fixed";
			ta.style.opacity = "0";
			document.body.appendChild(ta);
			ta.select();
			try { document.execCommand("copy"); } catch {}
			document.body.removeChild(ta);
			done();
		}
	};
	return /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("button", {
		type: "button",
		onClick: doCopy,

function getAchProgress(id, p) {
	switch (id) {
		case "first_match": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.matchesPlayed),
			max: 1
		};
		case "crew_win_1": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.crewWins),
			max: 1
		};
		case "imp_win_1": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.impostorWins),
			max: 1
		};
		case "neutral_win_1": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.neutralWins),
			max: 1
		};
		case "task_master": return {
			cur: Math.min(10, p.totalTasks),
			max: 10
		};
		case "task_legend": return {
			cur: Math.min(15, p.totalTasks),
			max: 15
		};
		case "killer_3": return {
			cur: Math.min(3, p.totalKills),
			max: 3
		};
		case "detective_eject": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.correctEjects),
			max: 1
		};
		case "ghost_helper": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.ghostAssists),
			max: 1
		};
		case "chat_communicator": return {
			cur: Math.min(5, p.chatsSent),
			max: 5
		};
		case "multi_floor": return {
			cur: p.unlockedAchievements.includes("multi_floor") ? 1 : 0,
			max: 1
		};
		case "survivor_5": return {
			cur: Math.min(3, p.matchesPlayed),
			max: 3
		};
		case "imp_master": return {
			cur: Math.min(3, p.impostorWins),
			max: 3
		};
		case "speedrunner": return {
			cur: typeof p.fastestCrewWinSec === "number" && p.fastestCrewWinSec <= 180 ? 1 : 0,
			max: 1
		};
		case "great_detective": return {
			cur: Math.min(5, Math.max(p.correctEjects, (p.maxEjectsInMatch || 0) >= 2 ? 5 : 0)),
			max: 5
		};
		case "first_discoverer": return {
			cur: Math.min(5, p.firstBodyReports || 0),
			max: 5
		};
		case "third_assassin": return {
			cur: Math.min(3, p.neutralWins),
			max: 3
		};
		case "shadow_assassin": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.shadowAssassins || 0),
			max: 1
		};
		case "perfect_work": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.perfectTaskWins || 0),
			max: 1
		};
		case "close_call": return {
			cur: Math.min(1, p.closeCallSaves || 0),
			max: 1
		};
		case "veteran_crew": return {
			cur: Math.min(10, p.matchesPlayed),
			max: 10
		};
		case "fashion_leader": return {
			cur: Math.min(6, Math.max(p.uniqueCosmeticsUsed?.length || 0, (p.customFullLoadoutMatches || 0) >= 5 ? 6 : 0)),
			max: 6
		};
		default: return null;
	}
}

var GameOverOverlay = ({ winner, reason, me, players, timeline, unlockedThisMatch, onPlayAgain, onReturnTitle, isHost }) => {
	const canvasRef = (0, import_react.useRef)(null);
	const all = Object.values(players).filter((p) => !p.isSpectator);
	const myWon = !!me && !!winner && (me.role === "survivor" && me.alive || winner === "crewmates" && isCrewRole(me.role) || winner === "impostors" && isImpostorRole(me.role) || me.role === winner);
	const winners = (0, import_react.useMemo)(() => {
		return all.filter((p) => {
			if (winner === "crewmates") return isCrewRole(p.role) || p.role === "survivor" && p.alive;
			if (winner === "impostors") return isImpostorRole(p.role) || p.role === "survivor" && p.alive;
			return p.role === winner || p.role === "survivor" && p.alive;
