// src/game/audio.ts
var SoundEngine = class {
	constructor() {
		this.ctx = null;
		this.muted = false;
		this.bgmMuted = false;
		this.bgmVolume = .24;
		this.sfxVolume = .75;
		this.mood = "title";
		this.step = 0;
		this.bgmTimer = null;
	}
	init() {
		if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
		if (!this.ctx) {
			const Ctx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
			if (Ctx) this.ctx = new Ctx();
		}
		if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === "suspended") this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
		if (!this.bgmMuted) this.startBgmLoop();
	}
	setSfxMuted(m) {
		this.muted = m;
	}
	setBgmMuted(m) {
		this.bgmMuted = m;
		if (m) this.stopBgmLoop();
		else {
			this.init();
			this.startBgmLoop();
		}
	}
	setBgmVolume(v) {
		this.bgmVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
	}
	setSfxVolume(v) {
		this.sfxVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
	}
	setMusicMood(m) {
		if (this.mood !== m) {
			this.mood = m;
			this.step = 0;
		}
	}
	startBgmLoop() {
		if (typeof window !== "undefined" && this.bgmTimer === null) this.bgmTimer = window.setInterval(() => {
			this.tickBgm();
		}, 340);
	}
	stopBgmLoop() {
		if (this.bgmTimer !== null && typeof window !== "undefined") {
			window.clearInterval(this.bgmTimer);
			this.bgmTimer = null;
		}
	}
	tickBgm() {
		if (this.bgmMuted || !this.ctx || this.ctx.state !== "running") return;
		const s = this.step++;
		const m = this.mood;
		const vol = this.bgmVolume * .18;
		if (vol <= .001) return;
		if (m === "title" || m === "lobby") {
			const notes = [
				220,
				261.63,
				329.63,
				392,
				440,
				523.25
			];
			if (s % 4 === 0) this.playBgmNote(notes[Math.floor(s / 4) % 4] / 2, "sine", .9, vol * .75);
			if (s % 2 === 0) this.playBgmNote(notes[s * 3 % notes.length], "triangle", .25, vol * .45);
		} else if (m === "playing") {
			const notes = [
				110,
				110,
				130.81,
				98,
				110,
				110,
				146.83,
				123.47
			];
			if (s % 2 === 0) this.playBgmNote(notes[Math.floor(s / 2) % notes.length], "triangle", .35, vol * .65);
			if (s % 8 === 3) this.playBgmNote(523.25, "sine", .4, vol * .28);
		} else if (m === "sabotage") {
			const notes = [
				146.83,
				155.56,
				146.83,
				138.59
			];
			this.playBgmNote(notes[s % notes.length], "sawtooth", .16, vol * .55);
			if (s % 2 === 0) this.playBgmNote(293.66, "square", .08, vol * .24);
		} else if (m === "meeting") {
			const notes = [
				261.63,
				311.13,
				392,
				466.16,
				392,
				311.13
			];
			if (s % 2 === 0) this.playBgmNote(notes[Math.floor(s / 2) % notes.length], "sine", .28, vol * .48);
			if (s % 6 === 0) this.playBgmNote(130.81, "triangle", .65, vol * .6);
		} else if (m === "victory") {
			const notes = [
				261.63,
				329.63,
				392,
				523.25,
				659.25,
				523.25,
				783.99
			];
			if (s < 14 && s % 2 === 0) this.playBgmNote(notes[Math.floor(s / 2) % notes.length], "triangle", .32, vol * .7);
		} else if (m === "defeat") {
			const notes = [
				220,
				207.65,
				196,
				164.81,
				146.83
			];
			if (s < 10 && s % 2 === 0) this.playBgmNote(notes[Math.floor(s / 2) % notes.length], "sawtooth", .4, vol * .45);
		}
	}
	playBgmNote(freq, type, dur, vol) {
		if (!this.ctx) return;
		try {
			const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
			const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
			const g = this.ctx.createGain();
			osc.type = type;
			osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
			g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(.001, vol), t);
			g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(8e-4, t + dur);
			osc.connect(g);
			g.connect(this.ctx.destination);
			osc.start(t);
			osc.stop(t + dur + .02);
		} catch {}
	}
	playTone(freq, type, dur, vol = .14, delay = 0) {
		if (this.muted || !this.ctx) return;
		try {
			const t = this.ctx.currentTime + delay;
			const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
			const g = this.ctx.createGain();
			osc.type = type;
			osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
			g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(.001, vol * this.sfxVolume), t);
			g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001, t + dur);
			osc.connect(g);
			g.connect(this.ctx.destination);
			osc.start(t);
			osc.stop(t + dur + .01);
		} catch {}
	}
	playClick() {
		this.playTone(640, "sine", .08, .1);
	}
	playChatSend() {
		this.playTone(720, "sine", .06, .08, 0);
		this.playTone(960, "triangle", .07, .08, .04);
	}
	playKeypadBeep(freq = 740) {
		this.playTone(freq, "triangle", .075, .11);
	}
	playWireConnect() {
		this.playTone(540, "triangle", .07, .12, 0);
		this.playTone(810, "sine", .09, .12, .045);
	}
	playLaserShot() {
		if (this.muted || !this.ctx) return;
		try {
			const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
			const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
			const g = this.ctx.createGain();
			osc.type = "sawtooth";
			osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(980, t);
			osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(210, t + .12);
			g.gain.setValueAtTime(.12 * this.sfxVolume, t);
			g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001, t + .13);
			osc.connect(g);
			g.connect(this.ctx.destination);
			osc.start(t);
			osc.stop(t + .13);
		} catch {}
	}
	playCardSwipe(ok) {
		if (ok) {
			this.playTone(587.33, "sine", .09, .13, 0);
			this.playTone(880, "triangle", .16, .15, .07);
		} else this.playErrorBuzz();
	}
	playErrorBuzz() {
		this.playTone(210, "sawtooth", .11, .12, 0);
		this.playTone(165, "sawtooth", .14, .12, .11);
	}
	playTaskVerifying() {
		this.playTone(480, "sine", .06, .08, 0);
		this.playTone(620, "sine", .07, .09, .12);
		this.playTone(760, "sine", .08, .1, .24);
	}
	playTaskDone() {
		this.playTone(523.25, "triangle", .12, .15, 0);
		this.playTone(659.25, "triangle", .12, .15, .08);
		this.playTone(783.99, "triangle", .14, .16, .16);
		this.playTone(1046.5, "sine", .34, .2, .24);
	}
	playKill() {
		this.playTone(180, "sawtooth", .16, .22, 0);
		this.playTone(95, "sawtooth", .28, .25, .08);
	}
	playShieldBlock() {
		this.playTone(440, "sine", .1, .18, 0);
		this.playTone(880, "triangle", .2, .2, .06);
	}
	playAlarm() {
		this.playTone(880, "square", .18, .16, 0);
		this.playTone(620, "square", .18, .16, .2);
		this.playTone(880, "square", .22, .16, .4);
	}
	playVent() {
		this.playTone(260, "sine", .15, .14, 0);
		this.playTone(140, "sine", .18, .14, .08);
	}
	playDoor() {
		this.playTone(190, "square", .12, .12, 0);
		this.playTone(120, "triangle", .18, .14, .07);
	}
	playStairs() {
		this.playTone(392, "sine", .08, .12, 0);
		this.playTone(587.33, "triangle", .12, .12, .07);
	}
	playVote() {
		this.playTone(480, "sine", .12, .12);
	}
	playWin() {
		[
			523.25,
			659.25,
			783.99,
			1046.5
		].forEach((f, idx) => this.playTone(f, "triangle", .28, .16, idx * .11));
	}
	playLose() {
		[
			329.63,
			293.66,
			246.94,
			174.61
		].forEach((f, idx) => this.playTone(f, "sawtooth", .34, .15, idx * .14));
	}
	playRoleReveal(team) {
		if (team === "impostor") {
			this.playTone(92, "sawtooth", .55, .22, 0);
			this.playTone(138.59, "sawtooth", .48, .16, .04);

		} else {
			this.playTone(261.63, "sine", .35, .16, 0);
			this.playTone(392, "triangle", .42, .16, .07);
			this.playTone(523.25, "sine", .48, .15, .14);
		}
	}
	playBodyReport() {
		this.playTone(146.83, "sawtooth", .36, .24, 0);
		this.playTone(73.42, "sawtooth", .5, .24, .02);
		this.playTone(880, "square", .16, .14, .1);

	playEject() {

	const timersRef = (0, import_react.useRef)([]);
	const clearAllTimers = () => {

		timersRef.current = [];
	};
	(0, import_react.useEffect)(() => {
		clearAllTimers();
		const tf = Math.floor(32 + Math.random() * 52);
		setTargetFreq(tf);
		setCurFreq(tf > 58 ? 20 : 82);
		setDlActive(false);
		setDlPct(0);
		setAstLeft(5);
		setAstPos({

		setSwipeMsg("カードを右端まで滑らかな速度でスライド！");
		setSwipeBadFlash(false);
		setSampleStep(0);
		setGoodIdx(Math.floor(Math.random() * 3));
		setSampleScanning(false);
		setHoldDown(false);
		setLeverPos(0);
		if (taskType === "reactor_sim") {
			const seq = Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 9));
			setSimSeq(seq);
			setSimStep(0);

// src/components/taskGames/PasscodeKeypadGame.tsx
var PasscodeKeypadGame = ({ onSuccess, onError, disabled }) => {
	const [targetCode, setTargetCode] = (0, import_react.useState)(() => String(Math.floor(1e3 + Math.random() * 9e3)));
	const [inputCode, setInputCode] = (0, import_react.useState)("");
	const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = (0, import_react.useState)(14);
	const [lockoutSec, setLockoutSec] = (0, import_react.useState)(0);
	const lockTimerRef = (0, import_react.useRef)(null);
	const triggerLockout = (0, import_react.useCallback)((msg) => {
		sound.playErrorBuzz();
		onError(msg);
		setInputCode("");
		setLockoutSec(1.7);
		if (lockTimerRef.current !== null) window.clearInterval(lockTimerRef.current);
		lockTimerRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
			setLockoutSec((prev) => {
				const next = Math.max(0, +(prev - .1).toFixed(1));
				if (next <= 0) {
					if (lockTimerRef.current !== null) {
						window.clearInterval(lockTimerRef.current);
						lockTimerRef.current = null;
					}
					setTimeLeft(14);
					setTargetCode(String(Math.floor(1e3 + Math.random() * 9e3)));
				}
				return next;
			});
		}, 100);
	}, [onError]);
	(0, import_react.useEffect)(() => {
		return () => {
			if (lockTimerRef.current !== null) window.clearInterval(lockTimerRef.current);
		};
	}, []);
	(0, import_react.useEffect)(() => {
		if (disabled || lockoutSec > 0) return;
		const t = window.setInterval(() => {
			setTimeLeft((prev) => {
				if (prev <= 1) {
					triggerLockout("タイムアウト！1.7秒間ロック後、やり直してください");
					return 14;
				}
				return prev - 1;
			});
		}, 1e3);
		return () => window.clearInterval(t);
	}, [
		disabled,
		lockoutSec,
		triggerLockout
	]);
	const handleDigit = (0, import_react.useCallback)((d) => {
		if (disabled || lockoutSec > 0 || inputCode.length >= 4) return;
		sound.playKeypadBeep(680 + Number(d) * 32);
		onError("");
		setInputCode((prev) => prev.length < 4 ? prev + d : prev);
	}, [
		disabled,
		inputCode.length,
		lockoutSec,
		onError
	]);
	const handleSubmit = (0, import_react.useCallback)(() => {
		if (disabled || lockoutSec > 0) return;
		if (inputCode === targetCode) {
			sound.playKeypadBeep(1046);
			onError("");
			onSuccess();
		} else triggerLockout("パスコード不一致！1.7秒間入力ロック＆初期化");
	}, [
		disabled,
		inputCode,
		lockoutSec,
		onError,
		onSuccess,
		targetCode,
		triggerLockout
	]);
	(0, import_react.useEffect)(() => {
		const onKey = (e) => {
			if (disabled || lockoutSec > 0) return;
			if (/^[0-9]$/.test(e.key)) {
				e.preventDefault();
				handleDigit(e.key);
			} else if (e.key === "Backspace") {
				e.preventDefault();
				setInputCode((prev) => prev.slice(0, -1));
			} else if (e.key === "Enter") {
				e.preventDefault();
				handleSubmit();
			}
		};
		window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
		return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
	}, [
		disabled,
		handleDigit,
		handleSubmit,
		lockoutSec
	]);
	const isLocked = lockoutSec > 0;
	return /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
		className: "space-y-3 text-center",
		children: [/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
			className: `rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 border p-3 transition ${isLocked ? "border-rose-500 bg-rose-950/60 keypad-err-flash" : "border-cyan-500/40"}`,
			children: [

var WireConnectGame = ({ onSuccess, onError, disabled }) => {

		sound.playErrorBuzz();

			leftId,
			rightId,
			x,
			y
		});
		if (errTimerRef.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(errTimerRef.current);
		errTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
			setErrorWire(null);
		}, 420);
	}, [onError]);
	const tryMatch = (0, import_react.useCallback)((leftId, rightId) => {
		if (disabled || matched[rightId]) return;
		if (leftId === rightId) {
			sound.playWireConnect();
			const next = {
				...matched,
				[rightId]: true
			};
			setMatched(next);
			setSelectedLeft(null);
			onError("");
			if (WIRE_DEFS.every((w) => next[w.id])) onSuccess();
		} else {
			setSelectedLeft(null);
			flashMismatch(leftId, rightId);
		}
	}, [
		disabled,
		flashMismatch,
		matched,
		onError,
		onSuccess
	]);
	const getBoardRelPos = (clientX, clientY) => {

		if (!el) return {

			y: 0,
			width: 400,
			height: 220
		};
		const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
		return {

			height: r.height
		};
	};

	});
	const getRightCenter = (rightId, w, h) => {

				const pos = getBoardRelPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);

					...prev,

					y: pos.y
				} : null);
			},
			onPointerUp: (e) => {
				if (!dragState) return;
				const pos = getBoardRelPos(e.clientX, e.clientY);

				if (pos.x >= pos.width * .6 && targetIdx >= 0 && targetIdx < rightOrder.length) {
					const targetId = rightOrder[targetIdx];
					if (!matched[targetId]) {
						tryMatch(dragState.colorId, targetId);
						setDragState(null);
						return;
					}
				}
				if (pos.x > 65) flashMismatch(dragState.colorId, void 0, pos.x, pos.y, "接続が外れました！右端まで繋いでください");

			},
			onPointerCancel: () => setDragState(null),

			children: [/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("svg", {

						if (!matched[w.id]) return null;
						const p1 = getLeftCenter(idx, bw, bh);
						const p2 = getRightCenter(w.id, bw, bh);
						const cx1 = p1.x + (p2.x - p1.x) * .45;
						const cx2 = p1.x + (p2.x - p1.x) * .55;
						return /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("path", {
							d: `M ${p1.x} ${p1.y} C ${cx1} ${p1.y}, ${cx2} ${p2.y}, ${p2.x} ${p2.y}`,
							fill: "none",
							stroke: w.hex,
							strokeWidth: "7",
							strokeLinecap: "round",
							style: { filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 6px ${w.glow})` }
						}, w.id);
					}),
					dragState && (() => {
						const idx = WIRE_DEFS.findIndex((w) => w.id === dragState.colorId);

var FirebaseConfigButton = () => {
	const [open, setOpen] = (0, import_react.useState)(false);
	const [text, setText] = (0, import_react.useState)(() => {
		try {
			return localStorage.getItem(FB_CONFIG_KEY) ? JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FB_CONFIG_KEY)), null, 2) : "";
		} catch {
			return "";
		}
	});
	const [msg, setMsg] = (0, import_react.useState)("");
	const parseCfg = (t) => {
		const out = {};
		["apiKey", "authDomain", "databaseURL", "projectId", "storageBucket", "messagingSenderId", "appId"].forEach((k) => {
			const m = t.match(new RegExp("[\"']?" + k + "[\"']?\\s*:\\s*[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']"));
			if (m) out[k] = m[1];
		});
		return out;
	};
	const save = () => {
		const cfg = parseCfg(text);
		if (!cfg.apiKey || !cfg.databaseURL) {
			setMsg("❌ apiKey と databaseURL（Realtime Database のURL）が必要です。");
			return;
		}
		try {
			localStorage.setItem(FB_CONFIG_KEY, JSON.stringify(cfg));
		} catch {}
		setMsg("✅ 保存しました。再読み込みします…");
		setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 600);
	};
	const clear = () => {
		try {
			localStorage.removeItem(FB_CONFIG_KEY);
		} catch {}
		window.location.reload();
	};
	return /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)(import_jsx_runtime.Fragment, { children: [/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("button", {
		type: "button",
		onClick: () => setOpen(true),

		onClick: () => setOpen(false),
		children: /* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsxs)("div", {
			className: "sf-panel rounded-3xl p-5 w-full max-w-lg space-y-3 border border-orange-400/50",
			onClick: (e) => e.stopPropagation(),
			children: [
				/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("div", { className: "font-black text-white", children: "🔥 Firebase オンライン接続設定" }),
				/* @__PURE__ */ (0, import_jsx_runtime.jsx)("div", {
					className: "text-[11px] text-slate-300 leading-relaxed",
					children: "Firebaseコンソールで Realtime Database を作成し、Webアプリの firebaseConfig（databaseURLを含む）を貼り付けてください。ルールは検証用に sid 配下の読み書きを許可する必要があります。未設定でも、PeerJS+STUNによるP2Pで追加設定なしにルームコードで対戦できます。Firebaseを設定すると、他デバイスの公開ルーム一覧・切断検知・P2P不可時の中継が使えます。"

		camWatchTimerRef.current = 0;
		camFeedRef.current = null;
		adminTimerRef.current = 0;
		setActiveTaskId(null);
		setSabotageModalOpen(false);
		setMapModalOpen(false);
		setTerminalMode(null);
		setCustomizeOpen(false);
		setRoleRevealOpen(false);
		setGameOverState({
			winner,
			reason
		});
		const me = playersRef.current[myIdRef.current];
		if (me && !me.isSpectator) {
			const prog = progressionRef.current;
			prog.matchesPlayed += 1;
			prog.surviveStreak = me.alive ? prog.surviveStreak + 1 : 0;
			const mId = activeMapIdRef.current || "starship";
			if (!prog.mapsPlayed.includes(mId)) prog.mapsPlayed = [...prog.mapsPlayed, mId];
			if (me.role === "survivor" && me.alive || winner === "crewmates" && hasTasksRole(me.role) || winner === "impostors" && isImpostorRole(me.role) || me.role === winner) {
				if (winner === "crewmates") {
					prog.crewWins += 1;
					const elapsed = Math.round(matchElapsedRef.current);
					if (prog.fastestCrewWinSec == null || elapsed < prog.fastestCrewWinSec) prog.fastestCrewWinSec = elapsed;
					const req = getPlayerTotalTasks(me, settingsRef.current.tasksPerPlayer);
					if (me.alive && hasTasksRole(me.role) && (me.tasksDone || 0) >= req) prog.perfectTaskWins = (prog.perfectTaskWins || 0) + 1;
				} else if (winner === "impostors") {
					prog.impostorWins += 1;
					if (me.alive && (me.killsCount || 0) >= 3) prog.shadowAssassins = (prog.shadowAssassins || 0) + 1;
				} else prog.neutralWins += 1;
				sound.playWin();
			} else sound.playLose();
			unlockAchievements();
		}
		broadcastState();
		forceRender();
	}, [
		broadcastState,
		forceRender,
		unlockAchievements
	]);
	const startMeeting = (0, import_react.useCallback)((reason, caller, victimId) => {
		if (phaseRef.current !== "playing") return;
		if (!caller || !caller.alive || caller.isSpectator) return;
		if (reason === "body" && victimId === caller.id) return;
		phaseRef.current = "meeting";
		meetingReasonRef.current = reason;
		meetingCallerRef.current = caller.name;
		meetingTimerRef.current = settingsRef.current.meetingTime;
		votesRef.current = {};
		resolvingVotesRef.current = false;
		sabotageRef.current = null;
		ventIdxRef.current = -1;
		camWatchTimerRef.current = 0;
		camFeedRef.current = null;
		adminTimerRef.current = 0;
		setActiveTaskId(null);
		setSabotageModalOpen(false);
		setMapModalOpen(false);
		setTerminalMode(null);
		setRoleRevealOpen(false);
		const victim = victimId ? bodiesRef.current.find((b) => b.victimId === victimId) : void 0;
		sound.playBodyReport();
		setReportCutIn({
			open: true,
			reason,
			callerName: caller.name,
			callerColor: caller.color,
			callerHat: caller.hat,
			victimName: victim?.victimName,
			victimColor: victim?.color
		});
		window.setTimeout(() => {
			setReportCutIn((prev) => ({
				...prev,
				open: false
			}));
		}, 2400);
		appendChatMessage({
			id: randomId(8),
			sender: "SYSTEM",
			text: reason === "body" ? `🚨 ${caller.name} が ${victim?.victimName || "仲間"} の遺体を発見し会議を招集しました！` : `🔔 ${caller.name} が緊急会議を招集しました！`,
			color: "#f97316",
			isSystem: true,
			ts: Date.now()
		});
		addTimeline({
			method: reason,
			text: reason === "body" ? `🚨 ${caller.name} が遺体通報（会議招集）` : `🔔 ${caller.name} が緊急会議ボタンを実行`
		});
		if (reason === "body" && caller.id === myIdRef.current) {
			progressionRef.current.firstBodyReports = (progressionRef.current.firstBodyReports || 0) + 1;
			unlockAchievements();
		}
		broadcastState();
		forceRender();
	}, [
		addTimeline,
		appendChatMessage,
		broadcastState,
		forceRender,
		unlockAchievements
	]);
	const resetPostSpawnCooldowns = (0, import_react.useCallback)((isMatchStart) => {
		const s = settingsRef.current;
		const myRole = playersRef.current[myIdRef.current]?.role || "crewmate";
		if (isMatchStart) {
			killCdRef.current = Math.max(0, s.spawnKillCooldown);
			sabotageCdRef.current = 12;
			abilityCdRef.current = 8;
			emergencyCdRef.current = 15;
		} else {
			killCdRef.current = Math.max(8, getEffectiveKillCooldown(myRole, s.killCooldown) * .6);
			sabotageCdRef.current = 12;
			abilityCdRef.current = 8;
			emergencyCdRef.current = 15;
		}
		ghostAssistCdRef.current = 5;
		ghostPrankCdRef.current = 5;
		ventCdRef.current = 0;
		Object.values(playersRef.current).forEach((p) => {
			if (p.isBot && (isImpostorRole(p.role) || p.role === "jackal")) p.botThinkTimer = (isMatchStart ? s.spawnKillCooldown : s.killCooldown * .65) + .6 + Math.random() * 1.4;
		});
	}, []);
	const resolveMeetingVotes = (0, import_react.useCallback)(() => {
		if (resolvingVotesRef.current) return;
		resolvingVotesRef.current = true;
		const { ejectedId, isTie } = tallyVotes(votesRef.current, playersRef.current);
		const s = settingsRef.current;
		const ejected = ejectedId ? playersRef.current[ejectedId] : null;
		const mapDef = MAPS[activeMapIdRef.current] || MAPS.starship;
		bodiesRef.current = [];
		Object.values(playersRef.current).forEach((p, idx, arr) => {
			p.inVent = false;
			p.disguisedAs = null;
			p.invisible = false;
			if (p.alive && !p.isSpectator) {
				const sp = getSpawnPosition(mapDef, idx, arr.length);
				p.x = sp.x;
				p.y = sp.y;
				p.vx = 0;
				p.vy = 0;
				p.floor = sp.floor;
			}
		});
		if (ejected) {
			ejected.alive = false;
			addTimeline({
				method: "eject",
				text: `🗳️ ${ejected.name} (${ROLES[ejected.role]?.jp || ejected.role}) が投票により追放`
			});
			if (ejected.role === "jester") {
				finishMatch("jester", `ジェスター（${ejected.name}）が会議で追放され単独勝利！`);
				return;
			}
			const execWinner = Object.values(playersRef.current).find((p) => p.alive && !p.isSpectator && p.role === "executioner" && p.executionerTargetId === ejected.id);
			if (execWinner) {
				finishMatch("executioner", `エクスキューショナー（${execWinner.name}）が標的 ${ejected.name} を追放させ単独勝利！`);
				return;
			}
			Object.values(playersRef.current).forEach((p) => {
				if (p.role === "executioner" && p.executionerTargetId === ejected.id) {
					p.role = "jester";
					p.executionerTargetId = void 0;
				}
			});
			if (isEvilRole(ejected.role)) {
				const prog = progressionRef.current;
				prog.correctEjects += 1;
				ejectsThisMatchRef.current += 1;
				prog.maxEjectsInMatch = Math.max(prog.maxEjectsInMatch || 0, ejectsThisMatchRef.current);
				unlockAchievements();
			}
			const evilText = s.confirmEjects ? `${ejected.name} は ${isEvilRole(ejected.role) ? "インポスター／人外" : "善良なクルー"} だった！（${ROLES[ejected.role]?.jp}）` : `${ejected.name} が船外へ追放された。`;
			const winAfterEject = checkWinCondition(playersRef.current, s);
			sound.playEject();
			setEjectionOverlay({
				open: true,
				text: evilText,
				subtext: winAfterEject ? winAfterEject.reason : "",
				ejectedColor: ejected.color,
				ejectedHat: ejected.hat
			});
			window.setTimeout(() => {
				setEjectionOverlay({
					open: false,
					text: "",
					subtext: "",
					ejectedColor: void 0,
					ejectedHat: void 0
				});
				if (winAfterEject) {
					finishMatch(winAfterEject.winner, winAfterEject.reason);
					return;
				}
				phaseRef.current = "playing";
				resetPostSpawnCooldowns(false);
				runRuntimeHealthCheck({
					phase: phaseRef.current,
					players: playersRef.current,
					bodies: bodiesRef.current,
					mapDef,
					assignedTasks: myTasksRef.current,
					validTaskIds: VALID_TASK_ID_SET,
					cooldowns: {
						killCooldown: killCdRef.current,
						sabotageCooldown: sabotageCdRef.current,
						abilityCooldown: abilityCdRef.current,
						emergencyCooldown: emergencyCdRef.current,
						ventCooldown: ventCdRef.current
					},
					onRepairCooldowns: (fixed) => {
						killCdRef.current = fixed.killCooldown;
						sabotageCdRef.current = fixed.sabotageCooldown;
						abilityCdRef.current = fixed.abilityCooldown;
						emergencyCdRef.current = fixed.emergencyCooldown;
						ventCdRef.current = fixed.ventCooldown;
					}
				});
				broadcastState();
				forceRender();
			}, 3100);
		} else {
			sound.playEject();
			setEjectionOverlay({
				open: true,
				text: isTie ? "同票のため追放は行われませんでした。" : "投票の結果、誰も追放されませんでした。",
				subtext: "（スキップ / 引き分け）",
				ejectedColor: void 0,
				ejectedHat: void 0
			});
			window.setTimeout(() => {
				setEjectionOverlay({
					open: false,
					text: "",
					subtext: "",
					ejectedColor: void 0,
					ejectedHat: void 0
				});
				phaseRef.current = "playing";
				resetPostSpawnCooldowns(false);
				broadcastState();
				forceRender();
			}, 2200);
		}
	}, [
		addTimeline,
		broadcastState,
		finishMatch,
		forceRender,
		resetPostSpawnCooldowns,
		unlockAchievements
	]);
	const startGame = (0, import_react.useCallback)((explicitMapId) => {
		const activePlayers = Object.values(playersRef.current).filter((p) => !p.isSpectator);
		if (activePlayers.length < 3) {
			showToast("ゲームを開始するには最低3人のプレイヤーが必要です（AI追加ボタンで補充できます）", "warn");
			return;
		}
		setCustomizeOpen(false);
		const s = settingsRef.current;
		const resolvedId = resolveMapSelection(explicitMapId || s.mapId, MAPS);
		activeMapIdRef.current = resolvedId;
		const mapDef = MAPS[resolvedId] || MAPS.starship;
		const assigned = assignRoles(activePlayers.map((p) => p.id), s);
		if (!activePlayers.some((p) => isImpostorRole(assigned.roles[p.id] || "crewmate")) && activePlayers.length > 0) {
			assigned.roles[activePlayers[0].id] = "impostor";
			console.warn("[RuntimeHealthGuard] 役職抽選でインポスター0人を検知したため安全補正しました");
		}
		activePlayers.forEach((p, idx) => {
			const sp = getSpawnPosition(mapDef, idx, activePlayers.length);
			const role = assigned.roles[p.id] || "crewmate";
			p.role = role;
			p.x = sp.x;
			p.y = sp.y;
			p.vx = 0;
			p.vy = 0;
			p.petX = sp.x - 28;
			p.petY = sp.y + 12;
			p.floor = sp.floor;
			p.alive = true;
			p.inVent = false;
			p.invisible = false;
			p.shielded = false;
			p.doused = false;
			p.disguisedAs = null;
			p.tasksDone = 0;
			p.totalTasks = getPlayerTotalTasks({
				role,
				totalTasks: 0
			}, s.tasksPerPlayer);
			p.killsCount = 0;
			p.prankedUntil = 0;
			p.botTarget = null;
			p.botTaskSpot = null;
			p.botTaskWorkTimer = 0;
			p.executionerTargetId = role === "executioner" && assigned.executionerTargetId ? assigned.executionerTargetId : void 0;
		});
		const me = playersRef.current[myIdRef.current];
		const myReqTasks = me ? getPlayerTotalTasks(me, s.tasksPerPlayer) : s.tasksPerPlayer;
		myTasksRef.current = assignTasks(mapDef, myReqTasks);
		completedTasksRef.current = {};
		bodiesRef.current = [];
		sabotageRef.current = null;
		oiledPlayersRef.current = {};
		timelineRef.current = [];
		matchElapsedRef.current = 0;
		ejectsThisMatchRef.current = 0;
		abilityTracesRef.current = [];
		killBurstsRef.current = [];
		ghostPulsesRef.current = [];
		visualEffectsRef.current = [];
		doorLogsRef.current = [];
		lastRoomPerPlayerRef.current = {};
		gimmickCooldownsRef.current = {};
		lockdownTimersRef.current = {};
		postWarpGraceRef.current = 0;
		if (me && me.color !== "cyan" && me.skin !== "standard" && me.hat && me.hat !== "none" && me.pet && me.pet !== "none") {
			progressionRef.current.customFullLoadoutMatches = (progressionRef.current.customFullLoadoutMatches || 0) + 1;
			unlockAchievements();
		}
		emergencyUsesRef.current = s.emergencyLimit;
		radarUsesRef.current = 3;
		teleporterUsesRef.current = 2;
		survivorShieldUsesRef.current = 3;
		doctorRevivedRef.current = false;
		ventIdxRef.current = -1;
		ventStayTimerRef.current = 0;
		camWatchTimerRef.current = 0;
		camFeedRef.current = null;
		camFeedIdxRef.current = 0;
		adminTimerRef.current = 0;
		camBatteryPctRef.current = 100;
		radarTimerRef.current = 0;
		psychicTimerRef.current = 0;
		trackedTargetIdRef.current = null;
		sonarTimerRef.current = 0;
		crystalBeaconTimerRef.current = 0;
		boostTimerRef.current = 0;
		bellTimerRef.current = 0;
		bellPosRef.current = null;
		hauntedTimerRef.current = 0;
		meteorActiveRef.current = false;
		meteorTimerRef.current = 0;
		nextMeteorInRef.current = 30 + Math.random() * 16;
		resetPostSpawnCooldowns(true);
		setActiveTaskId(null);
		setSabotageModalOpen(false);
		setMapModalOpen(false);
		setTerminalMode(null);
		setUnlockedThisMatch([]);
		setGameOverState({
			winner: null,
			reason: ""
		});
		phaseRef.current = "playing";
		setRoleRevealOpen(true);
		if (me && !me.isSpectator) sound.playRoleReveal(ROLES[me.role]?.team || "crew");
		runRuntimeHealthCheck({
			phase: phaseRef.current,
			players: playersRef.current,
			bodies: bodiesRef.current,
			mapDef,
			assignedTasks: myTasksRef.current,
			validTaskIds: VALID_TASK_ID_SET,
			cooldowns: {
				killCooldown: killCdRef.current,
				sabotageCooldown: sabotageCdRef.current,
				abilityCooldown: abilityCdRef.current,
				emergencyCooldown: emergencyCdRef.current,
				ventCooldown: ventCdRef.current
			},
			onRepairCooldowns: (fixed) => {
				killCdRef.current = fixed.killCooldown;
				sabotageCdRef.current = fixed.sabotageCooldown;
				abilityCdRef.current = fixed.abilityCooldown;
				emergencyCdRef.current = fixed.emergencyCooldown;
				ventCdRef.current = fixed.ventCooldown;
			}
		});
		appendChatMessage({
			id: randomId(8),
			sender: "SYSTEM",
			text: `🚀 作戦開始！ステージ「${mapDef.name}」に出航しました。`,
			color: "#38bdf8",
			isSystem: true,
			ts: Date.now()
		});
		broadcastState();
		forceRender();
	}, [
		appendChatMessage,
		broadcastState,
		forceRender,
		resetPostSpawnCooldowns,
		showToast,
		unlockAchievements
	]);
	const syncMyCustomization = (0, import_react.useCallback)((patch) => {
		const me = playersRef.current[myIdRef.current];
		if (me) Object.assign(me, patch);
		if (phaseRef.current === "lobby") {
			if (isHostRef.current && !isOfflineRef.current) broadcastState();
			else if (!isHostRef.current && guestConnRef.current?.open) try {
				guestConnRef.current.send({
					kind: "CUSTOMIZE",
					playerId: myIdRef.current,
					name: myNameRef.current,
					color: myColorRef.current,
					skin: mySkinRef.current,
					hat: myHatRef.current,
					pet: myPetRef.current,
					killEffect: myKillFxRef.current
				});
			} catch {}
		}
		forceRender();
	}, [broadcastState, forceRender]);
	const setupHostPeer = (0, import_react.useCallback)((code, attempt = 0) => {
		if (!getPeerCtor(getTransportMode() === "relay")) return;
		cleanupPeer();
		const useRelay = getTransportMode() === "relay";
		useRelayRef.current = useRelay;
		const peer = new (getPeerCtor(useRelay))(`SID-${code}`, { config: P2P_ICE_CONFIG, debug: 1 });
		peerRef.current = peer;
		peer.on("open", () => {
			migratingRef.current = false;
			showToast(`🌐 ${useRelay ? "Firebase中継" : "P2P"}ルーム ${code} を作成しました`, "info");
			const pubInfo = () => ({
				hostName: playersRef.current[myIdRef.current]?.name || myNameRef.current || "クルー",
				mapId: activeMapIdRef.current,
				transport: useRelay ? "relay" : "p2p"
			});
			if (FB.cfg && isPublicRoomRef.current) {
				if (useRelay && peer.setPublic) peer.setPublic(pubInfo());
				else if (!useRelay) {
					const push = () => FB.publish(code, {
						...pubInfo(),
						playerCount: 1 + Object.keys(peerConnsRef.current).length,
						phase: phaseRef.current
					});
					push();
					clearInterval(pubTimerRef.current);
					pubTimerRef.current = setInterval(push, 8e3);
				}
			}
		});
		peer.on("error", (err) => {
			console.error("[P2P:host] error", err && err.type, err);
			if (err && err.type === "host-superseded") {
				showToast("⚠️ 別のホストが引き継ぎました。ルームに再参加します。", "warn");
				const c = roomCodeRef.current;
				setTimeout(() => joinRoomRef.current && joinRoomRef.current(c, false, myIdRef.current), 300);
				return;
			}
			if (err && err.type === "unavailable-id" && migratingRef.current && !useRelay && (attempt || 0) < 6) {
				setTimeout(() => setupHostRef.current && setupHostRef.current(code, attempt + 1), 2e3);
				return;
			}
			if (err && err.type === "unavailable-id" && migratingRef.current) {
				migratingRef.current = false;
				const c = roomCodeRef.current;
				setTimeout(() => joinRoomRef.current && joinRoomRef.current(c, false, myIdRef.current), 600);
				return;
			}
			if (err && err.type === "unavailable-id" && attempt < 4) {
				const next = randomId(6);
				roomCodeRef.current = next;
				showToast(`🔁 ルームコード衝突のため ${next} に再発行しました`, "info");
				setupHostPeer(next, attempt + 1);
				forceRender();
				return;
			}
			showToast("⚠️ オンラインP2P接続エラー。AI追加やオフラインでもプレイできます。", "warn");
		});
		peer.on("disconnected", () => {
			try { if (!peer.destroyed) peer.reconnect(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[P2P:host] reconnect failed", e); }
		});
		peer.on("connection", (conn) => {
			conn.on("open", () => {
				peerConnsRef.current[conn.peer] = conn;
			});
			conn.on("data", (raw) => {
				if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return;
				if (raw.kind === "JOIN") {
					const pid = String(raw.playerId || conn.peer);
					connPlayerRef.current[conn.peer] = pid;
					const spectate = !!raw.spectate || phaseRef.current !== "lobby" && !playersRef.current[pid];
					const existing = playersRef.current[pid];
					if (existing) {
						existing.name = String(raw.name || existing.name);
						existing.color = String(raw.color || existing.color);
						existing.skin = raw.skin || existing.skin || "standard";
						existing.hat = String(raw.hat || existing.hat);
						existing.pet = String(raw.pet || existing.pet);
						existing.killEffect = String(raw.killEffect || existing.killEffect || "classic");
					} else {
						const mapDef = MAPS[activeMapIdRef.current] || MAPS.starship;
						const activeCount = Object.values(playersRef.current).filter((p) => !p.isSpectator).length;
						const sp = getSpawnPosition(mapDef, activeCount, activeCount + 1);
						const takenColors = new Set(Object.values(playersRef.current).filter((p) => !p.isSpectator).map((p) => p.color));
						let pickedColor = String(raw.color || "cyan");
						if (takenColors.has(pickedColor)) pickedColor = PLAYER_COLORS.find((c) => !takenColors.has(c.id))?.id || pickedColor;
						playersRef.current[pid] = {
							id: pid,
							name: String(raw.name || "クルー"),
							color: pickedColor,
							skin: raw.skin || "standard",
							hat: String(raw.hat || "none"),
							pet: String(raw.pet || "none"),
							killEffect: String(raw.killEffect || "classic"),
							role: "crewmate",
							x: phaseRef.current === "lobby" ? 140 + activeCount % 5 * 85 : sp.x,
							y: phaseRef.current === "lobby" ? 118 + activeCount % 2 * 32 : sp.y,
							petX: 110,
							petY: 130,
							floor: sp.floor,
							facing: 1,
							alive: !spectate,
							isSpectator: spectate,
							tasksDone: 0,
							totalTasks: settingsRef.current.tasksPerPlayer,
							killsCount: 0,
							inVent: false
						};
					}
					appendChatMessage({
						id: randomId(8),
						sender: "SYSTEM",
						text: spectate ? `👁️ ${String(raw.name || "クルー")} が観戦として接続しました。` : `🟢 ${String(raw.name || "クルー")} が参加/再接続しました！`,
						color: "#34d399",
						isSystem: true,
						ts: Date.now()
					});
					broadcastState();
					forceRender();
				} else if (raw.kind === "CUSTOMIZE") {
					const p = playersRef.current[String(raw.playerId)];
					if (p && phaseRef.current === "lobby") {
						p.name = String(raw.name || p.name).slice(0, 14);
						const requestedColor = String(raw.color || p.color);
						if (!Object.values(playersRef.current).some((other) => other.id !== p.id && !other.isSpectator && other.color === requestedColor)) p.color = requestedColor;
						if (raw.skin) p.skin = raw.skin;
						if (raw.hat) p.hat = String(raw.hat);
						if (raw.pet) p.pet = String(raw.pet);
						if (raw.killEffect) p.killEffect = String(raw.killEffect);
						broadcastState();
						forceRender();
					}
				} else if (raw.kind === "MOVE") {
					const p = playersRef.current[String(raw.playerId)];
					if (p && !p.isSpectator) {
						p.x = Number(raw.x ?? p.x);
						p.y = Number(raw.y ?? p.y);
						p.floor = raw.floor === 2 ? 2 : 1;
						p.facing = raw.facing === -1 ? -1 : 1;
						p.inVent = !!raw.inVent;
						p.invisible = !!raw.invisible;
						p.shielded = !!raw.shielded;
						if (typeof raw.petX === "number") p.petX = raw.petX;
						if (typeof raw.petY === "number") p.petY = raw.petY;
					}
				} else if (raw.kind === "CHAT" && raw.message) {
					appendChatMessage(raw.message);
					broadcastState();
				} else if (raw.kind === "VOTE") {
					const vid = String(raw.playerId);
					const tid = String(raw.targetId);
					if (phaseRef.current === "meeting" && playersRef.current[vid]?.alive && !votesRef.current[vid]) {
						votesRef.current[vid] = tid;
						sound.playVote();
						broadcastState();
						forceRender();
					}
				} else if (raw.kind === "TASK_DONE") {
					const p = playersRef.current[String(raw.playerId)];
					if (p) {
						p.tasksDone = (p.tasksDone || 0) + 1;
						const win = checkWinCondition(playersRef.current, settingsRef.current);
						if (win) finishMatch(win.winner, win.reason);
						else broadcastState();
						forceRender();
					}
				} else if (raw.kind === "SABOTAGE") {
					const t = raw.sabotageType;
					sabotageRef.current = {
						type: t,
						timer: t === "reactor" ? 35 : t === "doors" ? 12 : 0
					};
					sound.playAlarm();
					broadcastState();
					forceRender();
				} else if (raw.kind === "FIX_SABOTAGE") {
					sabotageRef.current = null;
					broadcastState();
					forceRender();
				} else if (raw.kind === "REPORT") {
					const caller = playersRef.current[String(raw.playerId)];
					const reason = raw.reason === "body" ? "body" : "emergency";
					const vid = raw.victimId ? String(raw.victimId) : void 0;
					const targetBody = vid ? bodiesRef.current.find((b) => b.victimId === vid) : void 0;
					if (caller && (reason !== "body" || canReportBody(caller, targetBody, phaseRef.current))) {
						if (caller.alive && !caller.isSpectator) startMeeting(reason, caller, vid);
					}
				} else if (raw.kind === "VISUAL_EFFECT" && raw.effect) {
					visualEffectsRef.current = [...visualEffectsRef.current.filter((v) => performance.now() <= v.expiresAt), {
						...raw.effect,
						expiresAt: performance.now() + 4200
					}];
					broadcastState();
				}
			});
			conn.on("close", () => {
				delete peerConnsRef.current[conn.peer];
				/* [GUARD_10] 切断プレイヤーの自動退出処理 */
				const pid = connPlayerRef.current[conn.peer];
				delete connPlayerRef.current[conn.peer];
				const gone = pid && playersRef.current[pid];
				if (gone && !gone.isBot && pid !== myIdRef.current) {
					if (phaseRef.current === "lobby") delete playersRef.current[pid];
					else {
						gone.alive = false;
						gone.isSpectator = true;
						gone.disconnected = true;
						if (phaseRef.current === "playing") {
							const win = checkWinCondition(playersRef.current, settingsRef.current);
							if (win) finishMatch(win.winner, win.reason);
						}
					}
					appendChatMessage({
						id: randomId(8),
						sender: "SYSTEM",
						text: `📴 ${gone.name} が切断されたため退出しました。`,
						color: "#f59e0b",
						isSystem: true,
						ts: Date.now()
					});
					broadcastState();
					forceRender();
				}
			});
		});
	}, [
		appendChatMessage,
		broadcastState,
		cleanupPeer,
		finishMatch,
		forceRender,
		showToast,
		startMeeting
	]);

	const joinRoomByCode = (0, import_react.useCallback)((code, spectate = false, reconnectId, forceRelay) => {

			else showToast("⚠️ P2P接続エラーが発生しました。", "warn");

			sabotageRef.current = null;
			sound.playTaskDone();

			progressionRef.current.sabotagesFixed += 1;
			if (prevSab?.type === "reactor" && prevSab.timer <= 10) progressionRef.current.closeCallSaves = (progressionRef.current.closeCallSaves || 0) + 1;

			else broadcastState();
			forceRender();
		} else if (act.kind === "task" && act.task) {
			clearInputs();
			if (act.task.isVisual && act.task.visualKind && act.taskSpot) {
				const vfx = {
					id: randomId(6),
					kind: act.task.visualKind,
					x: act.taskSpot.x,
					y: act.taskSpot.y,
					floor: act.taskSpot.floor || me.floor || 1,
					playerName: me.name,
					expiresAt: performance.now() + 4500
				};
				visualEffectsRef.current = [...visualEffectsRef.current.filter((v) => performance.now() <= v.expiresAt), vfx];
				if (!isHostRef.current && !isOfflineRef.current && guestConnRef.current?.open) guestConnRef.current.send({
					kind: "VISUAL_EFFECT",
					effect: vfx

			}
			setActiveTaskId(act.task.id);
		} else if (act.kind === "gimmick" && act.gimmick) {
			const g = act.gimmick;
			const key = getGimmickKey(g);
			if ((g.type === "camera" || g.type === "admin" || g.type === "vitals" || g.type === "doorlog") && settingsRef.current.cameraBatterySec > 0 && camBatteryPctRef.current <= 3) {
				showToast("🪫 監視バッテリーが空です！充電されるまでお待ちください。", "warn");
				return;
			}
			if (g.type === "camera") {
				camFeedRef.current = g;

				camFeedIdxRef.current = 0;

				adminTimerRef.current = g.durationSec || 6;
				setMapModalOpen(true);
				sound.playClick();
			} else if (g.type === "vitals") {
				setTerminalMode("vitals");
				sound.playClick();
			} else if (g.type === "doorlog") {
				setTerminalMode("doorlog");
				sound.playClick();
			} else if (g.type === "teleport") {
				const resolved = resolveTeleportTargetCoords(g, mapDef, me.floor || 1);
				if (resolved) {
					const safe = resolveSafePos(resolved.x, resolved.y, mapDef, resolved.floor);
					me.x = safe.x;
					me.y = safe.y;
					me.vx = 0;
					me.vy = 0;
					me.floor = resolved.floor;
					postWarpGraceRef.current = POST_WARP_GRACE_SEC;

				sound.playStairs();
				showToast(`🌀 ${g.label || "ワープ装置"}で移動しました！`, "info");
			} else if (g.type === "sonar") {
				sonarTimerRef.current = g.durationSec || 5;
				gimmickCooldownsRef.current[key] = g.cooldownSec || 15;
				sound.playClick();
				showToast("📡 ソナーパルスで船内の位置を探知中！", "info");

				gimmickCooldownsRef.current[key] = g.cooldownSec || 18;
				sound.playDoor();
				showToast(`🚧 ${g.label || "緊急シャッター"}を封鎖しました`, "warn");
			} else if (g.type === "boost_vent") {
				boostTimerRef.current = g.durationSec || 6;
				gimmickCooldownsRef.current[key] = g.cooldownSec || 14;
				sound.playClick();
				showToast("⚡ 加速ジェットで移動速度アップ！", "info");

				bellPosRef.current = {
					x: g.x,
					y: g.y

				gimmickCooldownsRef.current[key] = g.cooldownSec || 12;
				sound.playAlarm();

			} else if (g.type === "emf_scanner") {

				if (nearbyBody) showToast(`👻 EMF反応あり！近くに倒れたクルーの気配 (${Math.round(Math.hypot(nearbyBody.x - me.x, nearbyBody.y - me.y))}px)`, "warn");

			}
			broadcastState();
			forceRender();
		} else if (act.kind === "emergency") {
			emergencyUsesRef.current = Math.max(0, emergencyUsesRef.current - 1);
			emergencyCdRef.current = 20;

				kind: "REPORT",

		clearInputs,
		forceRender,
		showToast,
		startMeeting,
		unlockAchievements

	const handleReport = (0, import_react.useCallback)(() => {
		const me = playersRef.current[myIdRef.current];
		if (!me || !me.alive || me.isSpectator || phaseRef.current !== "playing") return;
		const floor = me.floor || 1;
		const found = bodiesRef.current.find((b) => canReportBody(me, b, phaseRef.current) && (b.floor || 1) === floor && Math.hypot(b.x - me.x, b.y - me.y) <= 108);
		if (!found) return;
		if (isHostRef.current || isOfflineRef.current) startMeeting("body", me, found.victimId);
		else if (guestConnRef.current?.open) guestConnRef.current.send({
			kind: "REPORT",
			playerId: me.id,
			reason: "body",
			victimId: found.victimId
		});
	}, [startMeeting]);
	const handleKill = (0, import_react.useCallback)(() => {
		const me = playersRef.current[myIdRef.current];
		const mapDef = MAPS[activeMapIdRef.current] || MAPS.starship;
		if (!me || !me.alive || me.isSpectator || phaseRef.current !== "playing" || !canUseKillButton(me.role) || killCdRef.current > 0 || me.inVent || me.invisible) return;
		const floor = me.floor || 1;
		const target = Object.values(playersRef.current).filter((p) => p.id !== me.id && p.alive && !p.isSpectator && !p.inVent && (p.floor || 1) === floor && !(isImpostorRole(me.role) && isImpostorRole(p.role))).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - me.x, a.y - me.y) - Math.hypot(b.x - me.x, b.y - me.y) || String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)))[0];
		/* [GUARD_09] closestTarget 単一ターゲットのみ */
		if (!target || Math.hypot(target.x - me.x, target.y - me.y) > 98) return;
		if (killCdRef.current > 0) return;
		if (isImpostorRole(me.role) || me.role === "jackal") killCdRef.current = Math.max(killCdRef.current, 0.05);
		if (me.role === "arsonist") {
			oiledPlayersRef.current[target.id] = true;
			target.doused = true;
			killCdRef.current = 16;
			sound.playClick();
			showToast(`🛢️ ${target.name} にオイルを塗布しました！`, "info");
			broadcastState();
			forceRender();
			return;
		}
		if (target.shielded) {
			killCdRef.current = getEffectiveKillCooldown(me.role, settingsRef.current.killCooldown) * .5;
			sound.playShieldBlock();
			showToast(`🛡️ ${target.name} はバリアで攻撃を弾きました！`, "warn");
			forceRender();
			return;
		}
		if (me.role === "sheriff" && !isEvilRole(target.role)) {
			me.alive = false;
			bodiesRef.current.push({
				id: randomId(8),
				victimId: me.id,
				victimName: me.name,
				color: me.color,
				role: me.role,
				x: me.x,
				y: me.y,
				floor,
				killedAt: Date.now(),
				killerName: `${me.name} (誤射)`
			});
			sound.playKill();
			showToast("💥 善良な市民を撃ってしまったため自滅しました…", "err");
			const win = checkWinCondition(playersRef.current, settingsRef.current);
			if (win) finishMatch(win.winner, win.reason);
			else broadcastState();
			forceRender();
			return;
		}
		target.alive = false;
		me.killsCount = (me.killsCount || 0) + 1;
		me.disguisedAs = null;
		killCdRef.current = getEffectiveKillCooldown(me.role, settingsRef.current.killCooldown);
		if (me.role === "sheriff") progressionRef.current.sheriffHits += 1;
		progressionRef.current.totalKills += 1;
		const fxColor = (PLAYER_COLORS.find((c) => c.id === me.color) || PLAYER_COLORS[0]).hex;
		killBurstsRef.current.push({
			id: randomId(6),
			x: target.x,
			y: target.y,
			floor,
			effectId: me.killEffect || "classic",
			colorHex: fxColor,
			startedAt: performance.now(),
			durationMs: 750
		});
		abilityTracesRef.current.push({
			x: target.x,
			y: target.y,
			floor,
			label: `🔪 殺害現場 (${me.name})`
		});
		bodiesRef.current.push({
			id: randomId(8),
			victimId: target.id,
			victimName: target.name,
			color: target.color,
			role: target.role,
			x: target.x,
			y: target.y,
			floor,
			killedAt: Date.now(),
			killerName: me.name,
			killerColor: me.color,
			dissolveTimer: me.role === "viper" ? 12 : void 0
		});
		addTimeline({
			method: "kill",
			killerName: me.name,
			victimName: target.name,
			roomName: getRoomName(target.x, target.y, mapDef, floor),
			floor,
			text: `🔪 ${me.name} (${ROLES[me.role]?.jp}) が ${target.name} を撃破`
		});
		sound.playKill();
		unlockAchievements();
		const win = checkWinCondition(playersRef.current, settingsRef.current);
		if (win) finishMatch(win.winner, win.reason);
		else {
			broadcastState();
			forceRender();
		}
	}, [
		addTimeline,
		broadcastState,
		finishMatch,
		forceRender,
		showToast,
		unlockAchievements
	]);

		const mapDef = MAPS[activeMapIdRef.current] || MAPS.starship;
		if (!me || ventIdxRef.current < 0 || mapDef.vents.length === 0) return;

	const handleAbility = (0, import_react.useCallback)(() => {
		const me = playersRef.current[myIdRef.current];
		const mapDef = MAPS[activeMapIdRef.current] || MAPS.starship;

			if (body && body.killerName) {

	(0, import_react.useEffect)(() => {
		const onKeyDown = (e) => {
			if (listeningAction) return;

			keysRef.current[e.code] = true;
			if (e.code === keybinds.use) {
				if (phaseRef.current === "lobby" && !customizeOpen) handleUse();
				else if (phaseRef.current === "playing" && !activeTaskId && !sabotageModalOpen && !mapModalOpen && !terminalMode) handleUse();
			} else if (e.code === keybinds.report) handleReport();
			else if (e.code === keybinds.kill) handleKill();
			else if (e.code === keybinds.vent) handleVent();
			else if (e.code === keybinds.sabotage) {
				const me = playersRef.current[myIdRef.current];
				if (me && me.alive && isImpostorRole(me.role) && !sabotageRef.current && sabotageCdRef.current <= 0) setSabotageModalOpen((v) => !v);
			} else if (e.code === keybinds.ability) handleAbility();
			else if (e.code === keybinds.map && phaseRef.current === "playing") setMapModalOpen((v) => !v);
			else if (e.code === "Tab" && camWatchTimerRef.current > 0) {
				e.preventDefault();
				const len = Math.max(1, camFeedRef.current?.feeds?.length || 1);
				camFeedIdxRef.current = (camFeedIdxRef.current + 1) % len;
				forceRender();
			} else if (e.code === "Escape") {
				setCustomizeOpen(false);
				setMapModalOpen(false);
				setSabotageModalOpen(false);
				setTerminalMode(null);
			}
		};
		const onKeyUp = (e) => {
			keysRef.current[e.code] = false;
		};
		window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
		window.addEventListener("keyup", onKeyUp);
		window.addEventListener("blur", clearInputs);
		return () => {
			window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
			window.removeEventListener("keyup", onKeyUp);
			window.removeEventListener("blur", clearInputs);
		};
	}, [
		activeTaskId,
		clearInputs,
		customizeOpen,
		forceRender,
		handleAbility,
		handleKill,
		handleReport,
		handleUse,
		handleVent,
		keybinds,
		listeningAction,
		mapModalOpen,
		sabotageModalOpen,
		terminalMode
	]);

		let lastTime = performance.now();
		let uiTimer = 0;
		let netTimer = 0;

					if (id === myIdRef.current || !p || typeof p.tx !== "number") continue;

				}

						facing: p.facing,
						petX: p.petX,
						petY: p.petY,
						isMe: p.id === myIdRef.current

					nearTerminal: lobbyNearTerminalRef.current,
					nowMs: now

				netTimer += dt;
				if (netTimer >= .08) {
					netTimer = 0;
					if (isHostRef.current && !isOfflineRef.current) broadcastState();
					else if (!isHostRef.current && guestConnRef.current?.open && me) try {
						guestConnRef.current.send({
							kind: "MOVE",
							playerId: me.id,
							x: me.x,
							y: me.y,
							floor: me.floor,
							facing: me.facing,
							petX: me.petX,
							petY: me.petY

				sabotageCdRef.current = Math.max(0, sabotageCdRef.current - dt);
				abilityCdRef.current = Math.max(0, abilityCdRef.current - dt);
				emergencyCdRef.current = Math.max(0, emergencyCdRef.current - dt);

				ghostPrankCdRef.current = Math.max(0, ghostPrankCdRef.current - dt);

						if (meteorTimerRef.current <= 0) {
							meteorActiveRef.current = false;
							nextMeteorInRef.current = 35 + Math.random() * 18;
						}
					} else {
						nextMeteorInRef.current -= dt;
						if (nextMeteorInRef.current <= 0) {
							meteorActiveRef.current = true;
							meteorTimerRef.current = 12;
							sound.playMeteor();
						}
					}

					if (sandstormTimerRef.current <= 0) {

						sandstormTimerRef.current = sandstormActiveRef.current ? 10 : 18;
					}

							sab.timer = Math.max(0, sab.timer - dt);
							if (sab.timer <= 0) {
								finishMatch("impostors", "炉心メルトダウンが臨界に達し、インポスター陣営が勝利しました！");
								raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
								return;
							}
						} else if (sab.type === "doors") {
							sab.timer = Math.max(0, sab.timer - dt);
							if (sab.timer <= 0) sabotageRef.current = null;
						}

						if (typeof b.dissolveTimer === "number") {
							b.dissolveTimer -= dt;
							return b.dissolveTimer > 0;

					if (me.role === "security" && me.shielded) speed *= 1.15;

							if (g.type === "ice") onIce = true;
							else if (g.type === "low_gravity") speed *= 1.18;
							else if (g.type === "conveyor") {
								convX += g.vx || 0;
